items.summary_en: Claude (Anthropic's AI assistant) is experiencing partially degraded service, according to its status page. Users seeing unusual behavior should check the status page before blaming their prompts and may retry later.
items.headline_zh: Claude 部分服務降級
items.summary_zh: Claude（Anthropic 的人工智能助理）可協助處理文字任務，官方狀態頁現顯示服務部分降級。用戶遇到異常時，與其先反覆修改提示詞，可先查看狀態頁並稍後再試；同類選擇可考慮 ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: Windows 与 macOS 的 3D 桌面小猫桌宠：响应全局键鼠、敲键追光标、摸猫呼噜；支持照片取色或 AI（内置 MCP）定制专属猫咪，闲置后睡觉。
items.summary_en: 7wdn/7paws - Windows 与 macOS 的 3D 桌面小猫桌宠：响应全局键鼠、敲键追光标、摸猫呼噜；支持照片取色或 AI（内置 MCP）定制专属猫咪，闲置后睡觉。 Gained 78 GitHub stars in 3 days (~84/day).

items.headline_en: llama.cpp shell tool adds required command descriptions
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source AI inference framework, now requires clients of its server shell tool to include a short plain-language description with each command. Clients can show that explanation instead of raw command text during streaming and in logs, making activity easier to understand and audit while calls without descriptions still run; Claude Code offers a comparable alternative.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp shell工具新增必填描述
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源AI推論框架）為server shell工具加入必填描述，客戶端可顯示一行白話指令解釋。以前串流與日誌只見原始指令，而家更易理解與審核；未帶描述嘅舊呼叫仍可運作。同類可選Claude Code。

items.headline_en: Codex Ships 0.174.0-alpha.1
items.summary_en: Codex, an AI coding agent, released version 0.174.0-alpha.1; the supplied release note lists no specific features or fixes.
items.headline_zh: Codex 發布 0.174.0-alpha.1
items.summary_zh: Codex（AI程式開發代理工具）推出0.174.0-alpha.1預覽版，公開資料只確認版本發布，未列功能或修復內容。用戶目前暫無改進可依據，不宜假定工作流程會變快或變簡單；同類選擇可留意GitHub Copilot

items.headline_en: OpenRouter Publishes November 24 Changelog Update
items.summary_en: OpenRouter, an AI model routing platform, published a changelog entry dated November 24, 2026, but the provided source does not specify any changes.
items.headline_zh: OpenRouter 發布 11月24日更新
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter（AI 模型路由平台）發布 2026年11月24日更新紀錄，但來源未列明新增功能或修正。用戶可在官方 Changelog 集中查閱變更，減少逐家追蹤模型供應商公告；同類選擇可留意 LiteLLM。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes Bonsai Timeout on iPhone
items.summary_en: The b12662 release of llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running language models locally, fixes a Metal GPU timeout affecting Bonsai on iPhone. iPhone users running Bonsai should see fewer failed GPU operations; MLC LLM is a comparable mobile-focused alternative.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp修正iPhone GPU逾時
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp係本機運行開源語言模型嘅推理框架；b12662版本更新修正Bonsai喺iPhone使用Metal GPU嘅逾時問題。以前或會因GPU逾時而中斷，而家可望減少失敗；同類選擇有MLC LLM。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Recommends Agents to Workspaces
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.214 updates the sidebar to recommend agents for a workspace instead of pinning them. Users can discover agents through sidebar recommendations, making it easier to find one for their workspace.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 新增 agent 推薦
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天框架）發布 CLI v0.0.214，側欄可向工作區推薦 agent。過往要找常用項或需手動固定，現在可從推薦著手，較易發現合適助手；想比較同類工作台，可看看 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: Ollama RC speeds up inkling2 with Metal kernels
items.summary_en: Ollama release candidate v0.40.18-rc0 adds inkling2-specific Metal kernels for faster decode, prefill, and draft rounds. Eligible Apple GPU generations and model sizes can use the optimized path, while others use the stock-graph fallback; a similar local-model option is LM Studio.
items.headline_zh: Ollama為inkling2加入Metal核心
items.summary_zh: Ollama（本地模型工具）RC 版為 inkling2 加入 Metal 核心，加快解碼、預填充與草稿輪次速度。合資格 Apple GPU 世代與模型尺寸可用路徑，其餘用通用圖；同類有 LM Studio。

items.headline_en: Ollama speeds up inkling2 with Metal kernels
items.summary_en: Ollama (open-source local model runner) 0.40.18 adds inkling2-specific Metal kernels for faster decoding, prefill, and draft rounds, gated by GPU generation and size class. Supported setups can deliver faster inference than the stock path, while others retain a stock-graph fallback; llama.cpp is a comparable local-inference option.
items.headline_zh: Ollama 新版為 inkling2 提速
items.summary_zh: Ollama（開源模型工具）v0.40.18 為 inkling2 加入 Metal 核心。它讓合資格 GPU 與模型的解碼、預填充及草稿輪次比以往通用路徑更快；不合資格仍回退通用圖。同類選擇可看 llama.cpp。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp expands OpenVINO support
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference framework, has updated its ggml-openvino backend with new model support and fixes. Users running llama.cpp with OpenVINO previously could hit compatibility failures around dynamic token dimensions, graph inputs and outputs without backing storage, or cached graphs; the update handles these cases more robustly, while CUDA is another backend to consider if OpenVINO is not a fit.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 強化 OpenVINO 支援
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源 AI 推論框架）更新 ggml-openvino 後端，加入模型支援並修正問題。用戶以往可能遇到相容性錯誤，現在動態 token 與快取處理更穩定，減少出錯；需要時可比較 CUDA 後端。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds OpenCL Speculative Verification
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, added a cooperative GEMM path for c8 Q6_K in OpenCL, covering speculative verification with n up to 8. OpenCL users gain an additional path for this quantized verification step, though no performance gain is reported; CUDA or Metal are alternative backends.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp新增OpenCL投機驗證
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地LLM推理框架）新增OpenCL c8 Q6_K協作式GEMM，可作最多n=8的投機驗證。用戶由原先欠缺此路徑，變為可用於量化驗證；速度仍待測試，亦可選CUDA或Metal。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp unifies typed RPC request handling
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running large language models locally, added typed RPC request helpers and centralized server-side validation. A shared command-to-message table lets client and server code use matching request and response structures, reducing duplicated per-command handling.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 統一型別化 RPC 請求
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（可在本機運行大型語言模型的開源工具）加入型別化 RPC 請求工具與伺服器端統一驗證，讓客戶端和伺服器共用指令對照的訊息結構。開發者過往要逐項處理，現可減少重複程式碼；同類選擇可看 Ollama。

items.headline_en: Inkling 2 Mini now available on AI Gateway
items.summary_en: Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines is now available on AI Gateway. The small multimodal reasoning model is built for agentic coding, tool use, and knowledge work, with text and image inputs and text output.Inkling 2 Mini has 26.4 billion total parameters and 3.4 billion active per token. The model runs its middle layers more than once for every token, which lets it reason further before writing anything down and often reach an answer with fewer reasoning tokens. Like Inkling 2 Small, it is st

items.headline_en: Local Unfiltered AI Chat on GitHub
items.summary_en: The TekihiXac52/unfiltered-ai-chat GitHub project provides unfiltered AI chat that runs on the user’s own machine. This local setup keeps conversations under the user’s control instead of relying on a hosted service, and the repository gained 66 stars in one day.
items.headline_zh: unfiltered-ai-chat本機AI對話
items.summary_zh: unfiltered-ai-chat 係 GitHub 上嘅本機 AI 聊天專案，主打無審查對話，聊天內容可留喺自己電腦並按個人規則設定。過往使用雲端 AI 聊天要依賴平台，而家可本機處理；同類選擇可看 Ollama。

items.headline_en: iOS simulators for AI agents, on Linux.
items.summary_en: Developing-Gamer/agent-sim - iOS simulators for AI agents, on Linux. The agent layer for x86Sim. Gained 599 GitHub stars in 4 days (~139/day).
fix editor config in master ( #32914 )

items.headline_en: llama.cpp updates MSVC quantization code
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source library for running language models locally, updated its quantization code in b12677 to make a local const variable static under MSVC. Windows developers may find MSVC builds smoother, while GNU toolchains offer an alternative.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 調整 MSVC 量化程式碼
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（可在本機運行語言模型的開源工具庫）b12677 版讓 MSVC 量化元件的局部 const 變數採 static。Windows 開發者建置或遇阻，現時或更順利；可用 GNU 工具鏈替代 MSVC。

items.headline_en: Rust 0.173.0-alpha.5 Released
items.summary_en: Rust, a general-purpose programming language, has released version 0.173.0-alpha.5.
items.headline_zh: Rust 發布 v0.173.0-alpha.5
items.summary_zh: Rust（通用程式設計語言）發布 v0.173.0-alpha.5 預覽版本，但資料未列明功能變更。用戶追蹤測試版時，過往只可參照較舊發布，現在可先記錄這個新版號，再待官方細節確認實際影響。同類選擇可考慮 C++。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp switches GDN to replay
items.summary_en: The b12676 llama.cpp release switches GDN handling from rollback to replay and moves rs_max with the sequence when find_slot swaps cells. For users, this reduces the risk of rollback being refused or snapshot mode restoring the previous owner's state incorrectly.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp GDN 改用 replay
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地推論框架）改用 replay 取代 rollback 處理 GDN，並修正交換儲存格時的記憶體狀態。降低序列繼承錯誤回退深度、導致回退被拒或 snapshot 還原異常的風險。同類：Ollama。

items.headline_en: Rust 0.172.0 Released
items.summary_en: Rust, the systems programming language, has released version 0.172.0, giving developers a new toolchain version to evaluate.
items.headline_zh: Rust 0.172.0 版本發布
items.summary_zh: Rust（以效能與記憶體安全見稱的系統程式設計語言）推出 0.172.0，讓開發者可由沿用舊版改為評估新工具鏈；今次資料未列明功能變更，實際效益仍須參考版本紀錄及測試。同類選擇可考慮 Go。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM Adds Proxy Provider Support
items.summary_en: LiteLLM v1.108.16 adds support for the litellm_proxy provider, allowing compatible models to be accessed through LiteLLM Proxy. Users can now route requests through the proxy instead of handling that integration separately.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM 新增 Proxy Provider 支援
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM 係用嚟統一管理及呼叫大型語言模型嘅開源工具。v1.108.16 新增 litellm_proxy provider，用戶而家可以經 LiteLLM Proxy 接入模型，毋須再自行處理相關整合；同類選擇亦包括其他 provider 整合方案。

items.headline_en: KuroCat Brings a Typing Cat to Desktops and OBS
items.summary_en: KuroCat is a free, open-source desktop typing cat and OBS overlay that reacts to keyboard input. Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android users can add a lightweight companion to streams and desktops instead of seeking a separate typing toy, with six designs, password masking, and AI petting; Bongo Cat is a similar alternative.
items.headline_zh: KuroCat：免費開源打字貓與OBS透明源
items.summary_zh: KuroCat（免費開源桌面打字貓）會跟住鍵盤輸入反應，並可作OBS透明源。想在桌面或直播加入打字效果，過往要另找工具，現可置頂顯示、密碼防偷窺，並支援AI捏貓及多平台；同類可選Bongo Cat。

items.headline_en: 本地优先的考公（公务员考试 / 国考 / 省考）多智能体 AI 学习系统：资料解析、知识挖掘、技能地图、RAG 问答、AI 出卷改卷与学情闭环。Self-hosted AI tutor for Chinese civil
items.summary_en: yijiejiang/kaogong-school - 本地优先的考公（公务员考试 / 国考 / 省考）多智能体 AI 学习系统：资料解析、知识挖掘、技能地图、RAG 问答、AI 出卷改卷与学情闭环。Self-hosted AI tutor for Chinese civil service exam prep. Gained 87 GitHub stars in 8 days (~456/day).

items.headline_en: LangChain HF 1.3.0 Fixes Tool Choice
items.summary_en: langchain-huggingface 1.3.0 is LangChain’s integration package for Hugging Face models, with fixes to forced tool choice and streaming token counts. Developers get more reliable tool selection and token counting during streaming; other LangChain provider packages offer similar integrations.
items.headline_zh: LangChain HF 1.3.0修正工具選擇
items.summary_zh: langchain-huggingface是LangChain的Hugging Face模型整合包；1.3.0版修正強制工具選擇與串流權杖計數。過往工具指定錯誤或串流統計偏差，現可避免；同類可選OpenAI整合包。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fetches Adreno Library During Build
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running AI models locally, now fetches the Adreno binary kernel library while configuring OpenCL builds. Adreno users can let the build retrieve the library instead of preparing it separately, with Vulkan another acceleration option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp自動取得Adreno核心庫
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp係本地運行AI模型嘅開源工具，新版會在配置OpenCL時自動取得Adreno專用二進制核心庫。Adreno用戶建置時毋須再手動預備該庫，減少設定步驟；亦可考慮Vulkan後端

items.headline_en: ContextBridge Validates AI Handoffs
items.summary_en: BoneD-Q's ContextBridge is a GitHub project that passes context between AI agents using structured evidence, uncertainty tracking, validation, and cross-agent knowledge transfer. It helps users keep traceable context when work moves between agents, instead of rebuilding it from scattered prompts.
items.headline_zh: ContextBridge 驗證 AI 脈絡交接
items.summary_zh: ContextBridge（跨 AI 代理交接工具）以結構化證據傳遞脈絡，追蹤不確定性、驗證知識並支援跨代理轉移。用戶過往靠零散提示交接，現可保留來源與脈絡，方便查核；需代理協作框架時，可比較 AutoGen。

items.headline_en: Codex Releases New Alpha Build
items.summary_en: Codex, OpenAI's AI coding assistant, released version 0.171.0-alpha.13.2. The release note gives no feature or fix details, so the only clear user benefit is access to a newer alpha build to try.
items.headline_zh: Codex 推出新版 alpha 測試版
items.summary_zh: Codex（OpenAI的AI程式開發工具）推出0.171.0-alpha.13.2測試版，更新內容未列明。用戶如一直沿用舊測試版，現時可轉試新版，但暫時無法確認有甚麼新增功能或修正；同類選擇可看其他AI程式開發工具。

items.headline_en: 3 questions that can help universities turn AI experiments into results
items.summary_en: The post 3 questions that can help universities turn AI experiments into results appeared first on Source .

items.headline_en: How Microsoft Discovery helps scientists learn from failure and find new possibilities
items.summary_en: The post How Microsoft Discovery helps scientists learn from failure and find new possibilities appeared first on Source .

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds NVFP4 Support on Metal
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference framework, added NVFP4 support to its Metal backend with new dequantization, matrix-multiplication, and tensor-operation kernels. Apple Silicon users can now run compatible NVFP4 models through Metal, which previously lacked support for that format.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 支援 Metal NVFP4
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源推理框架）的 Metal 後端新增 NVFP4，加入解量化及矩陣運算功能。Metal 過往未支援該格式，現可於 Apple Silicon 運行模型；想用圖形介面，可比較 LM Studio。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Connects Agent CLIs
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI added the `lh agent connect` command for linking external agent CLIs. It gives CLI users a built-in way to establish those connections instead of relying only on each external agent’s own CLI.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 加入 Agent 連接
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（AI 對話工具）的 CLI 新增 lh agent connect，可連接外部 agent CLI。過往要自行處理外部 agent，現在可用指令建立連接；或直接使用各 agent 本身的 CLI。

items.headline_en: ChatGPT outage resolved
items.summary_en: ChatGPT, OpenAI's conversational AI assistant, has returned to normal status, with all systems operational and the earlier issue resolved. Users can access the service normally again.
items.headline_zh: ChatGPT 服務恢復正常
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT（OpenAI 的對話式 AI 助手）狀態頁顯示所有系統已恢復運作，此前暫時服務問題已解決。用戶現可重新正常使用對話等服務，毋須再等待故障處理；需要替代方案時，也可轉用其他 AI 助手。

items.headline_en: RoboTrack Applies Point Tracking to Robot Manipulation
items.summary_en: Hugging Face introduced RoboTrack, a point-tracking approach for robotic manipulation in real-world environments. It lets manipulation systems track target points through visual scenes, helping robotic software respond to changes in an object's position.
items.headline_zh: RoboTrack將點追蹤用於真實機械操作
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face Blog介紹RoboTrack，一款面向真實世界機械操作的點追蹤方法。它可追蹤影像中的目標點位置，讓機械臂操作程式掌握目標點如何移動，令視覺判斷更貼近現場變化；同類選擇可比較其他影像點追蹤模型。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Agent Grant Table
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat workspace, shipped cli-release/v0.0.212 with a channel_agent_grants table for owner-approved agents. Users gain a foundation for permission tracking, though the release does not confirm a finished control panel; Open WebUI is a comparable alternative.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 新增 Agent 授權表
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天介面）v0.0.212 新增 channel_agent_grants，記錄擁有人批准的 Agent。過往欠缺授權記錄，可為權限追蹤打底；未顯示完整介面。同類如 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Compact Bias to Flash Attention
items.summary_en: llama.cpp (an open-source framework for local model inference) adds compact-bias support to the existing ggml FLASH_ATTN_EXT operation in release b12670, alongside a CPU reference implementation and an indexed-bias test. The user workflow does not change; developers can use a more compact path for indexed bias, while Ollama offers a comparable local-inference option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 加入緊湊 Bias 支援
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地推論框架）版本 b12670 為 Flash Attention 加入緊湊 Bias，並加入 CPU 參考實作及測試。用戶毋須改動操作流程，開發者可採精簡路徑；同類工具可比較 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.211 Adds Request Security Fix
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.211 adds a security fix for server-side requests involving user-supplied AI provider settings. Users configuring custom providers now benefit from safer request handling and reduced exposure to unsafe requests.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修補伺服器端請求風險
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）推出 CLI v0.0.211，為用戶自訂 AI 供應商相關的伺服器端請求加上防護。以前相關請求欠缺守護，現可降低處理不安全請求的風險；同類選擇可考慮 AnythingLLM。

items.headline_en: LangChain-Qdrant 1.2.0 Released
items.summary_en: LangChain's Qdrant integration released version 1.2.0, updating filelock from 4.2.5 to 4.2.10 and adjusting security lock resolutions for newer Python versions. It removes end-of-life Python 3.10 support, so users receive updated dependencies with the package, while Python 3.10 users must upgrade before adopting it.
items.headline_zh: LangChain Qdrant整合推出新版
items.summary_zh: LangChain Qdrant整合（Qdrant向量庫套件）推出1.2.0，更新filelock及Python保安鎖定。用戶毋須手動更新依賴；Python 3.10已終止支援，用戶須升級，同類選擇有Chroma整合。

items.headline_en: NVIDIA Shares Holiday Gaming and Making Ideas
items.summary_en: NVIDIA’s AI Blog shared a holiday roundup about using NVIDIA technologies to play, build, and create. The post offers gift and hobby inspiration, including starting a new game, for readers looking to explore a new interest.
items.headline_zh: NVIDIA分享節日遊戲與創作點子
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA AI Blog（官方部落格）整理節日內容，介紹如何運用NVIDIA技術遊玩、打造及創作，鼓勵人從遊戲或製作開啟新興趣。過節送禮由揀商品，變成按對方愛好挑科技專案，讓雙方接觸創作；同類可選聖誕遊戲或創客體驗。

items.headline_en: LangChain Releases Perplexity Package 1.5.0
items.summary_en: LangChain, an AI application framework, released version 1.5.0 of its Perplexity integration package, dropping end-of-life Python 3.10 support in partner packages and patching vulnerable dependencies. Python 3.10 users may need to upgrade for those packages, while the patches address known flaws; a similar alternative is LlamaIndex.
items.headline_zh: LangChain更新Perplexity套件
items.summary_zh: LangChain（AI框架）的Perplexity套件推出1.5.0，移除合作套件中已終止支援的Python 3.10，並修補有漏洞的相依套件。3.10用戶現或須升級，但可減低風險；同類選擇有LlamaIndex。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds BF16 Matrix Support on Metal
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM runtime, adds BF16/F32 source-operand support for MUL_MAT and MUL_MAT_ID on the Metal backend. This gives Apple Silicon users a BF16 option for those matrix operations, while direct tensor reads still preserve F32.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp Metal支援BF16運算
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本機推論語言模型的開源工具）為Metal後端加入BF16/F32來源支援。Apple Silicon用戶的相關運算可走BF16而非F16；tensor直讀仍保留F32。同類可選Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Filters Models by Tier
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, the AI chat project’s command-line tool, released v0.0.210 with controls that hide models above a member’s workspace tier. Users now see fewer unavailable options, while LiteLLM offers a comparable gateway option for custom model-access rules.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI按工作區級別隱藏模型
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）的命令列介面發布v0.0.210，可按會員工作區級別隱藏超出層級的模型。用戶毋須再瀏覽當前權限範圍外的模型，選單更貼合方案；想自訂模型存取規則，亦可比較LiteLLM閘道方案。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Batch Topic PR Retrieval
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat workspace, released v0.0.209 with a Work API that retrieves pull requests for up to 100 visible topics in a fixed number of queries and archives topics whose pull requests have been merged. GitHub App users can now collect linked PRs across many topics in one call instead of querying each topic separately.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat新增批量主題PR讀取與封存
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（AI聊天工作台）新增工作API，一次讀取最多100個主題的關聯Pull Request，並封存合併PR的主題。GitHub App用戶從前要逐個查找，現可批量取得連結，GitHub CLI屬同類選擇。

items.headline_en: LangChain Ollama 1.2.0 Refreshes Dependencies
items.summary_en: LangChain Ollama (the LangChain integration for Ollama models) released version 1.2.0. For developers, the update removes end-of-life Python 3.10 from partner packages, relaxes third-party dependency bounds, updates certifi and fixes dependency issues, reducing version-related installation and maintenance friction.
items.headline_zh: LangChain Ollama 更新依賴
items.summary_zh: LangChain Ollama（Ollama模型整合套件）推出1.2.0，於夥伴套件移除終止支援的Python 3.10，並放寬依賴上限、修正依賴問題。過往整合或受版本限制，可減少安裝維護疑難；同類可選其他連接器。

items.headline_en: langchain-tests 1.2.0 Drops Python 3.10 Support
items.summary_en: langchain-tests, a LangChain testing package, released 1.2.0, dropping Python 3.10 support for text_splitters, model_profiles, and standard-tests while updating dependencies. Users no longer need to maintain Python 3.10 compatibility and can focus on supported versions; for general Python testing, pytest is an alternative.
items.headline_zh: langchain-tests 1.2.0 發布
items.summary_zh: langchain-tests（測試工具套件）1.2.0 移除部分模組對終止支援的 Python 3.10 支援，並更新依賴。用家毋須維護 Python 3.10 測試環境，可專注受支援版本；通用測試可選 pytest。

items.headline_en: MiniMax Pricing Page Adds Three Prices
items.summary_en: MiniMax, an AI company that provides models and APIs, added price points of $0.011, $0.022, and $0.038 to its pricing page. Users who budgeted using the old page should check the latest plan prices before paying to avoid unexpected costs.
items.headline_zh: MiniMax 定價頁新增三個價位
items.summary_zh: MiniMax（AI模型與API平台）的定價頁新增$0.011、$0.022及$0.038價位。用戶過往若按舊頁估算費用，現應先查看最新定價再付款，避免開支與預期不符；同類選擇可比較其他模型API的收費。

items.headline_en: LangChain Text Splitters 1.2.0 Released
items.summary_en: Changes since langchain-text-splitters==1.1.3 release(text-splitters): 1.2.0 ( #41998 ) chore(text-splitters): bump mistune from 3.3.3 to 3.3.4 in /libs/text-splitters ( #42006 ) chore(infra): update vulnerable development dependencies ( #41933 ) feat: Remove EOL'd Python 3.10 from text_splitters, model_profiles and standard-tests ( #41343 ) build(text-splitters): constrain setuptools to patched releases ( #41485 ) revert: patch vulnerable integration dependencies ( #41481 ) build(deps): patch v
items.headline_zh: LangChain Text Splitters 1.2.0 發布
items.summary_zh: LangChain Text Splitters 係用嚟將長文拆成適合檢索嘅文字塊嘅工具。1.2.0 更新 mistune、修补易受攻擊依賴，並移除已停止支援嘅 Python 3.10；使用受影響版本嘅用戶要改用仍受支援嘅 Python，同類選擇有 LangChain 本身整合。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Adds Guidance for Token Write Failures
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released CLI v0.0.208. The fix tells a CLI run what to do when its token cannot write, giving users clearer guidance instead of leaving them without a next step.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正寫入失敗提示
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）CLI發布v0.0.208，修正token無法寫入時欠缺下一步指引的問題。用戶過去遇到這情況或不知如何處理，CLI現可給予明確指示；同類AI介面可選Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: ChatGPT Service Degraded
items.summary_en: ChatGPT, an AI chatbot, is reporting partial system degradation on its status page. Users can check that page before assuming their prompts are responsible.
items.headline_zh: ChatGPT 輕微系統降級
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT（AI聊天機器人）的狀態頁顯示服務出現「輕微」部分系統降級。用戶遇到異常時，可先查閱狀態頁，毋須立即歸咎提示詞；同類選擇還有Google Gemini。

items.headline_en: OpenHands v1.44.0 updates chat and automations
items.summary_en: OpenHands, an open-source AI software-development agent, released v1.44.0 with conversation mentions behind a feature flag, selectable automation visibility, clearer budget-limit errors, and an editable automation key-value store. The release gives users clearer control over who can see automations and easier ways to inspect stored values and understand when a budget is reached.
items.headline_zh: OpenHands 1.44.0 更新聊天與自動化
items.summary_zh: OpenHands（開源AI程式代理）發布v1.44.0，新增對話提及（需啟用旗標）、自動化可見範圍、預算超限提示及鍵值儲存區編輯。用戶過去較難追查提及、權限與執行狀態，現在可直接管理自動化流程。同類選擇如Cursor。

items.headline_en: Rust releases new alpha build
items.summary_en: Rust, a systems programming language, released v0.172.0-alpha.2.1. The alpha build lets developers test the new release early, while production use still requires stability and compatibility checks.
items.headline_zh: Rust 發布新版 alpha 預覽版
items.summary_zh: Rust（系統程式設計語言）發布 v0.172.0-alpha.2.1 預覽版本，內容未列功能變更。開發者過去要等正式版，現可提早試用作預先驗證；正式環境宜先測試穩定性與相容性，亦可等候 Rust 穩定版。

items.summary_en: n8n (workflow automation software) released version 2.49.5 on November 23, 2026, fixing two core issues: refreshing cached tokens during expirable-credential tests and returning items that hold values the VM expression engine cannot copy. Users can now test expiring credentials with a refreshed cached token and retrieve items affected by the expression-engine issue; Zapier is another comparable option.
items.headline_zh: n8n 2.49.5 發布，修正兩項核心問題
items.summary_zh: n8n（工作流程自動化平台）推出2.49.5版，修正在測試到期憑證時刷新快取權杖，亦可讓VM運算式引擎無法複製的值隨項目回傳。以前測試憑證或處理項目可能失敗，現可刷新憑證快取並取得含有該值的項目；同類選擇有Zapier。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Dedicated Visitor Chat Pages
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an AI chat workspace, now lets users open visitor conversations from Share settings on dedicated pages with their own sidebar. This keeps visitor chats out of the agent’s topic sidebar and provides a direct way back to Share.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 訪客對話新增獨立頁面
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（AI 聊天平台）可從 Share 設定將訪客對話開成獨立頁面，附側欄及返回 Share 的入口。過往對話會混入 Agent 主題側欄，現時可分開查看，共用內容更易整理。同類平台亦可選 ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Removes Coding Experience Lab
items.summary_en: LobeChat (an open-source AI chat platform) removed its “Better Coding Experience” lab in v0.0.205. The separate lab entry is gone, but the release note does not specify what happened to its features; Open WebUI is a similar open-source chat interface.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat移除「更佳編碼體驗」實驗室
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）版本v0.0.205移除「Better Coding Experience」實驗室，該實驗區不再保留。用戶少一個入口，但公告未說明功能去向或替代方案。同類可選Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp improves CUDA MMQ handling
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, released an update to ggml-cuda that handles zero blocks during few-row MMQ quantization. CUDA users can handle this edge case more reliably in such workloads; another local AI runtime option is Ollama.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 更新 CUDA 零值區塊處理
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（可在本機運行大型語言模型的開源推論框架）更新 ggml-cuda，少量列 MMQ 量化現可處理零值區塊。CUDA 用戶以往或遇相關處理不當，現在推論更穩健；另一選擇是 Ollama 等本機 AI 執行工具。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI fixes cron weekday ranges
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat workspace, released CLI v0.0.204 with fixes for rendering weekday ranges in cron tasks and preserving qualified cron patterns when schedule settings are edited. Users can now view weekly task ranges correctly and avoid losing schedule conditions after editing settings.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat修正cron星期範圍顯示
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI對話工作台）發布CLI v0.0.204，修正cron任務星期範圍顯示，編輯排程時保留具限定條件的cron規則。用戶毋須手動核對每週範圍，改設定後也較不易遺失排程條件；同類排程工具可比較n8n。

items.headline_en: Your AI agents, live on a pixel-art stage.
items.summary_en: tarqmamdouh/agent-theater - Your AI agents, live on a pixel-art stage. Works with Claude Code. Gained 174 GitHub stars in 4 days (~48/day).

items.headline_en: LobeChat Fixes Reply Loss
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released v0.0.203 with an OpenCode fix. Completed responses now remain available after a web search is canceled, sparing users from repeating finished work.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 修復搜尋取消後回覆遺失
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）發布 v0.0.203，修復 OpenCode 在網頁搜尋被取消後遺失已完成回覆的問題。過往已生成內容可能消失，現在則會保留，讓用戶少做重複工作；同類選擇亦可留意 Chatbox。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Fixes CLI Rescanning
items.summary_en: LobeChat released cli-release/v0.0.202, fixing rescans so heterogeneous agents can discover command-line tools installed after deployment. Users can rescan to make new CLIs available to agents without restarting; Dify is an alternative for self-hosted AI workflows.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 修復部署後 CLI 掃描
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天與代理平台）發布 v0.0.202，修復異質代理重新掃描，可偵測部署後安裝的命令列工具（CLI）。用戶重新掃描便可讓代理使用新裝 CLI，毋須重啟；自架 AI 工作流亦可比較 Dify。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI fixes AI agent tool handling
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.201 fixes AI-agent handling so turn-selected and @agent-delegation tools remain enabled. Users can keep selected tools available for delegated tasks without needing to re-enable them each time.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正AI代理工具狀態
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天框架）CLI 發布 v0.0.201，修正智慧代理處理本回合選取工具及代理委派工具的啟用狀態。以往已選工具未能保持啟用，委派任務可沿用選項，減少反覆開關工具的麻煩；同類可選 Dify。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Agent Shares Need No Login
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released v0.0.200 with support for signed-out visitors to read shared agent profiles. Users can now open an agent’s share link without signing in, instead of needing an account just to view it.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 分享頁現可免登入閱讀
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）發布 v0.0.200，容許未登入訪客閱讀已分享的 AI 代理頁面。過往查看分享或需先登入，現在可直接開啟連結；同類選擇可考慮 ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: Claude Service Restored
items.summary_en: Claude, Anthropic's AI assistant, is back to normal after an earlier service issue. All systems are operational, so users can access Claude as usual again.
items.headline_zh: Claude 服務恢復正常
items.summary_zh: Claude 是 Anthropic 推出的 AI 對話助手，先前服務異常現已解決，狀態頁顯示所有系統運作正常。用戶現時可如常使用，不再因服務中斷受阻；同類選擇包括 ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: LobeChat v0.0.199 Shows Workspace Nicknames
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat app, released v0.0.199 with support for showing members by the nickname they use within each workspace. It is used in member search and pickers, mentions, task-assignee and author fields, channel message authors and member lists, collaborator lists, and agent task tools, so users can recognize people by the names they use within each workspace; full name, @handle, or email serve as fallbacks.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 顯示工作區成員暱稱
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 對話工作台）新增工作區成員暱稱功能，會依序以暱稱、全名、@帳號及電郵辨識成員。以往要靠全名或@帳號辨人，現在搜尋、提及、任務指派及協作者名單可直接見到慣稱；備援顯示則為全名、@帳號或電郵

items.headline_en: llama.cpp treats KleidiAI files as vendored
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, now treats KleidiAI files as vendored in its CMake builds. Developers can use the bundled sources without separately fetching or managing them, simplifying project setup.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 內嵌 KleidiAI 檔案
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地大型語言模型推論框架）發布 b12655，在 CMake 建置中把 KleidiAI 檔案視為內嵌來源。開發者毋須另行取得及管理這些檔案，設定依賴更直接；同類推論工具另有 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.198 Fixes Knowledge Base Routing
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, the open-source AI chat platform’s command-line component, releases v0.0.198 with a knowledge-base routing fix. The update routes documents by their exact extension, giving users more precise file handling when organizing knowledge-base content.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正知識庫文件分流
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（LobeChat 的命令列工具）發布 v0.0.198，修正按完整副檔名分流知識庫文件。用戶過往難以按文件類型正確分流，現可依副檔名歸檔，減少設定錯誤；同類平台可比較 Dify。

items.headline_en: LobeChat v0.0.197 Retires Advanced Tools Switch
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat workspace, removed the Advanced Tools switch in v0.0.197 and exposed message branching, same-topic thread creation, token breakdowns, and a resizable model panel. Users no longer need a master switch for these features, while per-reply model and usage displays now sit behind a separate Conversation display toggle, off by default; those who previously enabled Advanced Tools keep it enabled.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 移除進階工具總開關
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天工作區）v0.0.197取消「進階工具」總開關，訊息分支、同話題討論及可調模型面板可直接使用。用戶毋須先開總開關；逐回覆模型與用量顯示改由對話設定控制，預設關閉。可改用對話切換自訂顯示。

items.headline_en: ggml Fixes CMake Math Library Check
items.summary_en: ggml, the C-based machine-learning tensor library used by llama.cpp, updated its CMake MATH_LIBRARY check by removing the DEFINED operator from if(). On Windows, when a parent project cannot find the math library, the old check could incorrectly evaluate the condition as true; the new logic evaluates it as false as intended, helping avoid an incorrect build branch.
items.headline_zh: ggml 修正 CMake 數學庫檢查
items.summary_zh: ggml（llama.cpp 採用的 C 語言機器學習張量庫）更新 CMake 檢查，移除 if() 的 DEFINED 運算子。Windows 上父專案找不到數學庫時，舊邏輯或會誤判條件為真；新邏輯會判為假，避免錯誤的建置設定分支。建置整合亦可比較 llama.cpp 的其他 CMake 設定。

items.headline_en: Claude Reports Partially Degraded Service
items.summary_en: Claude (Anthropic's AI assistant) is reporting partially degraded service on its status page. If Claude is not working normally, users can check the status page before blaming their prompts.
items.headline_zh: Claude 部分服務降級
items.summary_zh: Claude（Anthropic 開發的 AI 對話助手）目前在狀態頁顯示「部分服務降級」，屬輕微服務異常。用戶若使用不順，應先查狀態頁，避免誤以為提示詞有問題；同類選擇亦有 ChatGPT 等助手。

items.headline_en: volta-forever Runs Unmodified CUDA 13 Programs on Tesla V100
items.summary_en: nbald/volta-forever is a compatibility layer in front of NVIDIA's driver library that lets unmodified CUDA 13 programs—including PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp—run on Tesla V100 GPUs (sm_70). V100 owners can keep existing hardware in use for CUDA 13 AI workloads without modifying their programs, and the repository gained 115 GitHub stars in three days.
items.headline_zh: V100 靠相容層運行 CUDA 13 程式
items.summary_zh: volta-forever 是 CUDA 13 相容層，讓 Tesla V100 不改程式運行 PyTorch、llama.cpp 等工具。用戶可續用舊卡做 AI 工作；或選原生支援 V100 的 CUDA 版本。

items.headline_en: Vercel Flags Stops Deployments With Missing Flags
items.summary_en: Vercel Flags, Vercel's feature-flag tool, can now block deployments from reaching production when code declares a flag that has not been created in the project. The check fails on missing definitions, preventing a silent fallback to a default value that could enable a feature intended to stay off.
items.headline_zh: Vercel Flags 攔截缺失旗標部署
items.summary_zh: Vercel Flags（功能旗標工具）可攔截缺漏旗標的部署：程式碼有旗標但專案未建立時，部署不能進入生產環境。過去應用或會靜默採用預設值，誤開原應關閉功能；現在缺漏即令檢查失敗。同類可選 LaunchDarkly。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds ROLL Support to WebGPU
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference engine, added ROLL support to its WebGPU backend in release b12651. WebGPU users can now run ROLL workloads on that backend, while portable tests help maintain consistent cases across other backends.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp WebGPU新增ROLL支援
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地AI推論引擎）為WebGPU加入ROLL支援，並用跨後端測試維持案例可攜。用戶現可讓需要ROLL的推論經WebGPU執行，毋須轉用其他GPU後端；CPU與CUDA亦是選擇。

items.headline_en: n8n Releases Version 1.123.101
items.summary_en: n8n, a workflow automation platform, released version 1.123.101 on November 23, 2026. The dated release listing gives users an upgrade reference, but no specific changes are identified, so checking the changelog before updating remains important.
items.summary_zh: n8n（工作流程自動化平台）於2026年11月23日發布1.123.101版本，但資料未列出新增功能或修正內容。用戶可先查閱版本說明再決定升級，避免盲目更新；同類選擇另有Zapier、Make。

items.headline_en: n8n 2.48.8 Improves Migration Reports
items.summary_en: n8n, a workflow automation platform, released version 2.48.8 on November 23, 2026, with fixes for end-to-end tests, QuickJS expression memory limits, and migration-report access and layout. Custom instance roles can now view migration reports, while the report controls stay within the editor on narrow screens.
items.headline_zh: n8n 2.48.8 改善遷移報告權限
items.summary_zh: n8n（工作流程自動化平台）推出2.48.8版，修復QuickJS運算式達記憶體上限時報錯等問題，並讓自訂實例角色查看遷移報告。用戶可按角色開放報告權限，在窄螢幕使用報告控制項亦不再越界；同類選擇可考慮 Zapier。

items.headline_en: n8n 2.49.4 Improves Permissions and Error Handling
items.summary_en: Workflow automation platform n8n released version 2.49.4, fixing AI Builder archive and unpublish permissions, Migration Report access for custom instance roles, QuickJS memory-limit handling, and narrow-screen report controls. Teams can apply one permission across every workflow in an AI Builder thread, let authorized roles review migration reports, and receive an explicit error when an expression hits the memory limit; Zapier is a comparable alternative.
items.headline_zh: n8n 2.49.4 更新權限與錯誤處理
items.summary_zh: n8n（流程自動化工具）發布2.49.4，修正AI Builder封存及下架權限、遷移報告自訂角色存取，並改善表達式超限時的錯誤提示。用戶可把權限統一套用至討論串流程，自訂角色可看遷移報告。同類選項有Zapier。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp b12650 refines Inkling chat grammar
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running large language models locally, released b12650 with improvements to the Inkling parser and grammar for chat handling. For users, the update means more refined handling of Inkling chat syntax in local-model setups.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 強化 Inkling 語法
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本機運行大型語言模型的開源工具）在 b12650 強化 Inkling 聊天解析器與語法。過往依原有方式處理相關語法，新版可更精細地解析，讓聊天格式設定更順妥；同類選擇另有 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Regroups Connected Apps
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released v0.0.196 with connected apps reorganized into OpenBot-style categories. The clearer grouping helps users locate connector apps by category instead of browsing them individually.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 重新整理應用分類
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）在v0.0.196把連接器中的應用重新整理成OpenBot風格分類。過往要找工具或要逐個瀏覽應用，現在可按分類更快定位；同類選擇亦包括Dify。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds XiELU for OpenCL
items.summary_en: The llama.cpp b12649 release adds an OpenCL implementation of the XiELU activation function. This expands backend compatibility for OpenCL users running models or kernels that rely on XiELU.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp為OpenCL加入XiELU
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（跨平台開源AI推理框架）發布b12649，為OpenCL後端加入XiELU啟用函數實作。以前OpenCL欠缺該運算支援，現在用戶可執行相關工作負載；其他選擇則有CUDA或Metal後端。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds One-Click Connector Requests
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an AI chat workspace, released v0.0.195 with a channel feature that lets an Agent request a connector through a one-click call to action. Users can now handle connector requests in context instead of leaving the conversation to find one themselves.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 新增 Agent 連接器請求
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天工作台）發布 v0.0.195，讓 Agent 可用一鍵按鈕向用戶請求連接器。以前要由用戶尋找並設定連接器，現在可回應 Agent 的需求；同類選擇還有 ChatGPT 等 AI 助手

items.headline_en: LobeChat Now Recognizes Lobot Desktop
items.summary_en: LobeChat v0.0.194 now recognizes the Lobot Desktop user agent and classifies it as a desktop client. Plugin write metrics carry a client_app tag, keeping Lobot versions out of LobeHub version buckets for more accurate usage reporting.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat新版辨識Lobot桌面端
items.summary_zh: Lobot Desktop（桌面用戶端）獲LobeChat新版辨識，可被分類為桌面客戶端。插件寫入統計加上client_app標記，避免Lobot版本再混入LobeHub分組，令插件統計更清晰；同類選擇有LobeHub。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Fixes Tool Event Matching
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released the v0.0.193 CLI update to reconcile unnamed tool-completion events in Antigravity. Previously, these events could be mismatched; the update lets the CLI align them correctly for more consistent tool-completion workflows, while Open WebUI is another option.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正工具事件配對
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 平台）發布 CLI v0.0.193，修正 Antigravity 未命名工具完成事件配對。過往未命名事件或會配對不一，CLI 可準確對齊，流程更一致；另一選擇是 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: AI Gateway Adds Canary ZDR Audits
items.summary_en: Vercel’s AI Gateway, which routes application requests to inference providers, now runs canary ZDR audits to detect when prompt content is read outside the inference path. Teams previously relied on ZDR contracts and point-in-time security audits, but can now add a detection layer as production infrastructure changes; independent security audits are a comparable option.
items.headline_zh: AI Gateway新增ZDR金絲雀審計
items.summary_zh: Vercel AI Gateway（讓應用程式呼叫模型推論服務的閘道）新增金絲雀零資料保留（ZDR）審計，偵測提示內容有否在推論路徑外被讀取。過往靠ZDR協議與時點審計，現在多一層偵測；同類選擇是供應商稽核工具。

items.headline_en: LobeChat separates agent settings from user memory
items.summary_en: LobeChat (an open-source AI chat app) released v0.0.192, routing instructions about an agent’s role, duties, name, or working directory to agent management rather than user memory. Users can configure one agent without those instructions being injected into their other agents, keeping shared preferences separate from each agent’s setup.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 將代理設定與用戶記憶分離
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天應用）發布更新，把代理的角色、職責與名稱設定交由代理管理，不再混入用戶記憶。此前設定代理時，指令會注入同帳戶其他代理；現在各代理設定與共享偏好分開，同類可選 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: Vercel AI Gateway Adds Audited Zero Data Retention
items.summary_en: Vercel AI Gateway, which routes AI inference requests, has introduced audited zero data retention (ZDR). Businesses handling source code, customer records, or regulated data can cite the audit as external assurance that processed data is not retained, making compliance evidence easier to provide.
items.headline_zh: Vercel AI Gateway 支援 ZDR
items.summary_zh: Vercel AI Gateway（企業嘅AI模型閘道）新增經審核零資料保留（ZDR），敏感資料經模型處理後不留存。過往難向外證明零資料保留，而家可憑審核增強合規信心；同類可選 Cloudflare AI Gateway。

items.headline_en: Vercel Drives Adds CLI and SDKs
items.summary_en: Vercel Drives, Vercel’s storage service, can now be managed through CLI commands and standalone TypeScript and Python SDKs. Developers can create, list, fork and delete drives directly, with a REST API and Drive-specific permissions, instead of relying on Sandbox APIs or permissions.
items.headline_zh: Vercel Drives 推出 CLI、SDK
items.summary_zh: Vercel Drives（Vercel 儲存服務）新增 CLI 與 SDK，支援建立、列出、複製和刪除。過往須用 Sandbox API 與權限，現可透過 SDK 直接管理；同類可選 Vercel Blob。

items.headline_en: AI Gateway Adds Extraction Models
items.summary_en: Vercel's AI Gateway now supports extraction models that find specific details in supplied content and return them as separate fields for code. ScaleDown Extract-1, the first available model, extracts text values or lists from text, images, and PDFs, letting developers process invoices, contracts, and other records with less manual extraction; AWS Textract is a comparable alternative.
items.headline_zh: AI Gateway 加入抽取模型
items.summary_zh: Vercel 的 AI Gateway 新增抽取模型，可從文字、圖片或 PDF 找出發票號碼、聯絡人姓名等資料，並回傳欄位。過去處理發票、合約要逐項抽取，現可交給程式處理；AWS Textract 亦是同類選擇。

items.headline_en: Kazunari Hanao joins Vercel as Country Manager, Japan
items.summary_en: 日本語版はこちら：Vercel日本法人の代表に花尾和成が就任いたしましたKazunari Hanao has joined Vercel as Country Manager for Japan, based in Tokyo. His appointment is part of our continued investment in the Japanese market, including plans to expand our local team.Japanese developers were early adopters of Next.js. And today, Vercel's customers in Japan include Mitsubishi Corporation, Fujitsu Limited, U-NEXT CO., Ltd., and DeNA Co., Ltd., alongside startups like SANU Inc. and Reiwa Travel, Inc.Kazunari has spent the last decade

items.headline_en: Vercel日本法人の代表に花尾和成が就任いたしました
items.summary_en: （本記事は、英語版の就任発表の日本語訳に、花尾本人の就任のご挨拶を加えたものです。）Vercel日本法人の代表に、花尾和成が就任いたしました（東京拠点）。今後、Vercelは花尾とともに国内のチームを拡充し、日本市場への投資をさらに進めていきます。弊社が10年以上前に公開したNext.jsを、日本の開発者の皆さまはいち早く使い始めてくださいました。そして現在、日本では三菱商事、富士通、U-NEXT、ディー・エヌ・エーといった大企業から、SANUや令和トラベルといったスタートアップまで、幅広い企業にVercelをご利用いただいています。花尾はこの10年間、日本でソフトウェア企業の運営にリーダーシップを発揮してきました。前職ではPendoの日本法人社長を務め、それ以前にはHashiCorpの日本事業を立ち上げ、Pivotalの東京オフィスで営業部門を統括しました。就任にあたり、花尾から皆さまへのメッセージをご紹介します。このたび、Vercelの日本法人代表に就任いたしました花尾和成です。私は20年以上IT業界に身を置き、そのうち10年以上は、開発者が開発そのものに集中できるようにするプロダ

items.headline_en: OpenRouter Adds November 23, 2026 Changelog Entry
items.summary_en: OpenRouter, an AI model routing platform, added a changelog entry dated November 23, 2026.
items.headline_zh: OpenRouter 發布 11 月 23 日變更紀錄
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter（AI 模型路由平台）新增 2026 年 11 月 23 日更新紀錄。現有資料只列日期，未交代功能或調整，用戶暫難判斷對日常工作流程有否改善；其他模型路由平台亦可比較。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Lists Official Remote MCP Servers
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat workspace, can now list vendors’ official remote MCP servers in its Connector. Users can discover integrations in the app instead of searching through each vendor’s documentation.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 加入官方 MCP 伺服器清單
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）新版在 Connector 列出供應商官方 remote MCP servers。用戶毋須逐家搜尋文件，便可在 App 內查看遠端 MCP 整合；同類 MCP 客戶端亦可比較。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds OpenCL Speculative Decoding
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running large language models locally, added OpenCL q4_k cooperative GEMM support for speculative verification and enabled it for sequences of two or more. This could improve inference performance on supported OpenCL hardware, though actual speed gains depend on the device and model.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 加入 OpenCL 推測解碼
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（在本機運行大型語言模型的開源工具）為 OpenCL 新增 q4_k 協作式 GEMM 推測驗證，並支援兩條以上序列，可望改善部分 OpenCL 裝置上的推理效能；實際速度仍視硬件與模型而定。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Narrows GDN Snapshot Comparison Tests
items.summary_en: llama.cpp is an open-source framework for running large language models locally, and release b12647 updates its tests to compare only guaranteed GDN snapshot slots. The narrower comparison gives developers a more focused validation target instead of checking non-guaranteed slots.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp收窄GDN快照測試範圍
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地大型語言模型執行框架）發布b12647，將GDN快照比對限定於保證槽位，讓開發者更聚焦核心測試；另列macOS、iOS與Linux驗證資料。只求易用部署亦可比較Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Fixes Agent Acknowledgement Display
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.190 fixes a channel list-preview issue that left an Agent's acknowledgement unmarked. Users can now see which items an Agent has acknowledged without opening each one.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 標示 Agent 確認
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天框架）的 CLI 發布 v0.0.190，修復 Agent 確認狀態未在列表預覽顯示的問題。用戶可一眼看出是否已確認，毋須逐項開啟；同類介面可參考 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Adds Cross-Folder Agent Discovery
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, the command-line tool for the open-source LobeChat AI chat framework, released v0.0.189 with hetero-agent discovery across every installation folder. Users can now have the CLI locate installed agents instead of checking each folder manually; Gemini CLI is a comparable option.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 發布跨資料夾代理搜尋
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（開源 AI 聊天工具）發布 v0.0.189，新增 hetero-agents 功能，可在每個安裝資料夾尋找代理。用戶過往要逐個位置查看，現可由 CLI 搜尋；同類可選 Gemini CLI。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp adds generic tensor memory fallback
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running language models locally, added a generic fallback for tensor memset in release b12646. Backends without a specialized path can now use the fallback to clear tensor memory, helping reduce memory-operation failures during local inference.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 為記憶體清零加通用後備
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機 AI 推理框架）為 tensor memset 加入通用後備，部分後端即使欠缺專用路徑，也可清零張量記憶體。用戶在本機推理時，可減少相關記憶體操作失敗；同類選擇有 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Auto-Names Default Channels
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released CLI v0.0.188 with automatic naming for a project’s default channel after its project owner. Users no longer need to rename default channels manually, making projects easier to identify.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 自動命名預設頻道
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）發布 CLI v0.0.188，專案預設 Channel 會按專案擁有者自動命名。以前要手動改名，現在會自動命名，較易辨識各專案；同類選擇有 ChatGPT、Claude。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes LFM2.5-VL Chat Template
items.summary_en: The llama.cpp b12645 release fixes chat-template detection for LFM2.5-VL. Users running this model through llama.cpp can now have the correct conversation template selected instead of a mismatched one.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp修正LFM2.5-VL聊天模板
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機大型語言模型工具）發布b12645版，修正LFM2.5-VL聊天模板偵測。過去模板配對錯誤可能令對話格式不對，現在可正確辨識並套用所需模板；想要簡單的本機操作，也可考慮同類工具Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat 0.0.187 patches request-routing security
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat app, released version 0.0.187 with a security fix for the routing of user-controlled image and ComfyUI requests. Affected requests now follow a revised route, reducing security risk for users.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat更新 修正請求路由安全問題
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天應用）發布0.0.187，更新以修正使用者控制的圖片及ComfyUI請求路由。過往相關請求循舊路徑處理，現改用修正後的路由，降低安全風險；同類選擇另有Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Speeds Up Shared Audio FFT
items.summary_en: The b12644 release of llama.cpp, an open-source AI inference framework, speeds up shared audio FFT by replacing recursive radix-2 splitting with iterative stages and batching odd-size DFT across subsequences while preserving the previous operation order. Users can benefit from faster audio processing and smaller input buffers, with new forward and inverse FFT tests; for cross-platform deployment, ONNX Runtime is another inference option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 加快共享音訊 FFT
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源AI推論框架）新版以迭代分段及批次DFT加快共享音訊FFT，維持原有運算次序。用戶的音訊處理可更快，輸入緩衝區亦更精簡，並新增正向與反向變換測試。跨平台部署亦可比較ONNX Runtime。

items.headline_en: Find the holes before someone else does.
items.summary_en: erkamyaman/safe-anything - Find the holes before someone else does. A fast, 100% Rust vulnerability scanner: XSS, SQL injection, leaked secrets, dependency CVEs and AI agent setups. Gained 721 GitHub stars in 4 days (~208/day).

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes Multi-Node Expert Copying
items.summary_en: llama.cpp fixed an issue where experts from a host weight shared across several nodes were only partially copied, leaving later matrix multiplications with stale data. This improves correctness for multi-node large language model inference, particularly with CPU mixture-of-experts setups.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正多節點專家複製
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp 是可在本機或多個節點執行大型語言模型的開源框架。新版修正多節點共用權重時，專家資料未完整複製、令後續運算使用過期資料的問題，提升 CPU 混合專家模型的推論正確性；同類選擇有 Hugging Face Transformers。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp updates Inkling2 vocab handling
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, enabled ignore_merges for Inkling2 in release b12641. The update makes local Inkling2 inference ignore vocabulary merge entries under the model-specific setting.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 加入 Inkling2 選項
items.summary_zh: 開源本地模型推論框架 llama.cpp 為 Inkling2 啟用 ignore_merges，可忽略詞表合併項。用戶過往未能套用這項規則，現在本地推論會按模型詞表設定處理；想簡化部署，亦可比較 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Grep Pagination
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, added offset pagination to the server's grep_search tool. Users can now retrieve matching results page by page instead of handling the entire result set at once.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 伺服器搜尋支援分頁
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機大型語言模型推論框架）伺服器新增 grep_search 工具的 offset 分頁。搜尋結果較多時，過往要自行整理整批匹配，現在可逐頁取回；想比較本機推論框架，也可看 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat adds Codex plan switch
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.186 adds a Codex Plan switch and a plan block under Better Coding. Users can select a Codex coding plan from the same interface, making plan configuration more convenient.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI新增Codex方案切換
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）CLI v0.0.186新增Codex Plan切換器，在Better Coding加入方案區塊。用戶現可直接切換Codex編碼方案，毋須另找入口；同類選擇有Codex CLI。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Token-Aware Chat Parsing
items.summary_en: The llama.cpp b12638 release adds token-aware parsing to its chat functionality. Developers can now use chat parsing that accounts for tokens instead of a token-unaware approach; Ollama offers a higher-level alternative for local models.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 支援 token 感知解析
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地運行大型語言模型的開源框架）b12638 在聊天功能加入 token 感知解析。過往解析未顧及 token，開發者現可採用按 token 處理的方式；同類介面可考慮 Ollama。

items.headline_en: Vercel AI Gateway Adds Country Filters
items.summary_en: Vercel AI Gateway, an AI request routing service, can now limit requests to providers headquartered in allowed countries or block providers in denied countries. This helps teams meet compliance and procurement rules about where their AI vendors are located; teams comparing options can also look at Cloudflare AI Gateway.
items.headline_zh: Vercel AI Gateway 新增總部國家篩選
items.summary_zh: Vercel AI Gateway（AI 請求路由服務）可按供應商總部國家設定允許或封鎖名單。過往需自行核對供應商所在地，現在更能配合合規及採購要求；同類選擇可看 Cloudflare AI Gateway。

items.headline_en: New Guide to Agentic Evaluation
items.summary_en: Hugging Face's blog has added a new guide to building and maintaining an agentic evaluation. Teams can follow it to establish and maintain an evaluation process rather than working it out alone; LangSmith is a comparable tooling option.
items.headline_zh: Hugging Face新增Agent評估指南
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face（AI模型平台）新增代理式評估教學，說明如何建立及維護AI Agent的評估流程。團隊以往要自行摸索標準，現可按任務設定評估並持續檢視表現；同類選擇可參考LangSmith評估工具。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes Qwen3 Audio Handling
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference framework, released a fix for Qwen3-Omni and Qwen3-ASR audio handling, removing extra tokens introduced by zero-padding and adding tests for the issue. Local users can avoid incorrect trailing tokens when processing Qwen3 audio; another local-inference option is Ollama.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 Qwen3 音訊尾端
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地AI推論框架）修正Qwen3-Omni、Qwen3-ASR音訊尾端，移除零填充造成的多餘詞元並加入測試。用戶以往處理Qwen3音訊時，可能遇到錯誤尾端詞元，現可避免；同類選擇另有Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat WSL
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI platform, released CLI v0.0.185 with support for finding and running agents installed in WSL. Windows users can now use the CLI to locate and launch these agents instead of searching for each one manually; another option is Claude Code.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 更新 WSL 支援
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 平台）發布 CLI v0.0.185，可尋找及執行 WSL 內已安裝的 agents。Windows 用戶可經 CLI 啟動 agents，毋須逐個查找；同類可選 Claude Code。

items.headline_en: LobeChat groups scheduled tasks by hour
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, now shows scheduled tasks in a table grouped by hour. Users can review planned work in one organized view instead of checking tasks separately.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 新增按小時分組的排程表
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）現可把已排程任務顯示成表格，並按小時分組。用戶以前要逐項查看，現可集中檢視各項工作，更容易掌握時間安排；需要同類排程功能，也可比較 ChatGPT Tasks。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Now Issues 64-Character API Keys
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, now issues 64-character API keys, including the prefix, using a cryptographically secure random number generator. Existing keys with 16-character suffixes remain valid, while the updated layout keeps revealed keys from pushing table columns and actions out of view.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat API 金鑰改為 64 字元
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 是開源 AI 聊天平台，現預設以密碼學安全隨機數產生器發出 64 字元 API 金鑰。既有 16 字元尾綴金鑰仍可用，不需逐一更換；介面亦重新排版，避免顯示金鑰時擠走表格操作。同類選擇可看 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Device Owner Q&A
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat workspace, released v0.0.182 with a Channel feature that lets users ask the device owner within a conversation. This lets users keep device-owner queries in the chat instead of moving them to another exchange.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat新增向裝置擁有者問答功能
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天工作台）推出v0.0.182，新增Channel功能，讓用戶可在現有對話中向裝置擁有者提問。要查詢裝置資訊時，毋須離開對話另行處理；同類開源選擇可看Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI adds OpenAPI support
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released CLI v0.0.181 with OpenAPI support for text, JSON, images, video, speech, and transcription. Users can now integrate these AI capabilities into their own tools and workflows instead of relying only on the chat interface.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 支援 OpenAPI
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 是開源 AI 聊天平台，CLI v0.0.181 新增文字、JSON、圖片、影片、語音及轉錄的 OpenAPI 支援。用戶能把這些功能接入自有流程，毋須只靠聊天介面；同類可選 Gemini CLI。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp patches clearing bug
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference framework, released b12633 with a ggml fix for nonzero clearing on WebGPU and non-UMA devices. Users running local AI on those setups can now avoid the faulty clearing path.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 ggml 清除錯誤
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源 AI 推論框架）發布 b12633，修正 ggml 對 WebGPU 及非 UMA 裝置的非零值清除。用戶的本地模型過往可能遇上清除問題，現可避開該路徑；同類選擇包括 llamafile。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI aligns Skills behavior
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, LobeChat's command-line tool, released v0.0.180 with changes aligning Skills prompts and activation fallback to the runtime. Users should see more consistent Skill behavior when invoking it from the terminal.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正 Skills 啟動行為
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI 是 LobeChat 的命令列工具，v0.0.180 將 Skills 提示詞及啟動後備機制與執行環境對齊。用戶以指令行調用技能時，設定與運作較不易不一致；同類選擇可看其他開源 AI CLI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI batches queued requests
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI is the command-line version of the open-source AI chat platform; v0.0.179 fixes channel handling to process a person's queued requests together in one run. Users can now have multiple pending requests answered in one batch instead of handling them separately.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 合併處理排隊請求
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI 是開源 AI 對話平台的命令列版本，v0.0.179 修復 Channel 排隊處理，可把同一人的多項請求合併一次執行。用戶毋須逐項處理排隊提示，現可由系統批次回答；同類選擇可考慮 Dify。

items.headline_en: LobeChat fixes image handling
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat interface, released v0.0.178 with support for Antigravity images and restored image copying. Users can once again copy images in chats and work with Antigravity images.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 修復圖片處理
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 是開源 AI 聊天介面，v0.0.178 支援 Antigravity 圖片並恢復圖片複製。用戶現可正常複製聊天圖片，不再如修正前般受故障影響；同類選擇可比較 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: Nexus Connects AI to Local Tools
items.summary_en: Nexus is a GitHub project that connects web AI assistants to local files, terminals, Git, and desktop tools through Model Context Protocol (MCP), with user-controlled permissions. It lets users handle local files and run commands with explicit permission, reducing manual tool-switching, and the project gained 495 GitHub stars in 10 days.
items.headline_zh: Nexus 連結網頁 AI 與本機工具
items.summary_zh: Nexus 是 GitHub 上的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）整合專案，可把網頁 AI 助理接到本機檔案、終端機、Git 和桌面工具，權限由用戶控制。過去助理較難直接處理本機開發資源，現在可在授權後處理檔案、執行指令，減少跨工具搬運資料。專案在 10 日內累積 495 個 GitHub stars。同類選擇有 Claude Desktop 等支援 MCP 的 AI 助理。

items.headline_en: LobeChat v0.0.177 fixes shared Works visibility
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released v0.0.177 with a fix so shared-link visitors can see the Works created by their replies. Visitors can now view results on shared pages instead of missing them; ChatGPT is a comparable AI chat option.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat v0.0.177修復分享頁Works顯示
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）發布v0.0.177，修復分享頁未顯示回覆所生成Works的問題。以前訪客可能看不到回覆產物，現可直接在分享頁查看結果；同類選擇可考慮ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: LobeChat v0.0.176 Shows Failed Agent Replies
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, has released CLI v0.0.176 with a feature that displays failed Agent replies as error cards. Users can now identify unsuccessful responses at a glance instead of mistaking them for usable replies.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 將失敗回覆顯示為錯誤卡
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）在 CLI v0.0.176 加入功能，把 Agent 的失敗回覆顯示為錯誤卡。以前用戶較難分辨錯誤訊息，現在可一眼辨識，避免誤當可用答案；需要類似錯誤提示時，也可比較 ChatGPT 等平台。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp fixes invalid GGUF enum values
items.summary_en: The b12636 release of llama.cpp, an open-source toolkit for running large language models locally, updates ggml/gguf to avoid creating invalid enum values from untrusted file data. This reduces malformed internal states when users load GGUF files from outside sources.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 GGUF 列舉值問題
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地模型推理工具）在 b12636 版更新 ggml/gguf，避免從不可信檔案建立無效列舉值。用戶以前載入外部 GGUF 檔案時可能出現無效內部狀態，現在可減少這類錯誤；同類還有 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp adds sigmoid gradients
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, has added a SIGMOID backward pass to its ggml backend. Developers can now run the sigmoid gradient operation required by Qwen3.5 hybrid models instead of being blocked by a missing operation.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 加入 Sigmoid 反向傳播
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機大型語言模型框架）的 ggml 後端新增 Sigmoid 反向傳播，補足 Qwen3.5 混合模型所需運算。開發者以前會因缺少梯度而受阻，現可執行相關反向計算；同類工具亦可選 PyTorch。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes JSON Tool Calls
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, the open-source LLM inference tool, updated its chat handler to trigger lazy grammar for bare JSON tool calls. Previously, tool_choice=auto yielded no grammar for plain JSON calls from models such as Llama 3.x; the update now matches the opening of the call object, so these calls can use a grammar.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正裸 JSON 工具呼叫
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源 LLM 工具）更新聊天功能，讓裸 JSON 工具呼叫觸發文法。Llama 3.x 配合 tool_choice=auto 時原本無文法；現會比對呼叫物件開頭，讓格式更可靠。同類如 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes NVFP4 Scaling on CDNA3
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference tool, released b12632 to fix the HIP backend’s double halving of NVFP4 scales on AMD CDNA3 GPUs. Users with affected hardware can avoid the previous incorrect scale adjustment and get more accurate numerical handling.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 CDNA3 縮放錯誤
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地推論工具）發佈b12632，修正HIP在AMD CDNA3上將NVFP4縮放值重複減半的問題。過往受影響硬件會錯誤調整縮放，現可避免重複處理，令數值計算更準確。同類工具亦可考慮Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Canary improves browser error recovery
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat workspace, published canary build v2.3.6-canary.1 with changes to web-browsing recovery, community workspace dependencies, Markdown prebundling, and the CLI. Users can now see crawl failures in tool results and benefit from a slimmer always-on prompt, while dependency and bundling fixes support steadier workspace setup.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat Canary 改善網頁瀏覽錯誤處理
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 是開源 AI 聊天工作台，今次 Canary 更新網頁瀏覽錯誤處理及社群工作區修復。用戶現可從工具結果查看爬取錯誤，常駐提示較以往精簡，操作更順；同類選擇另有 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat v2.3.5 Updates Agent Colors
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat framework, released v2.3.5 with an AI-assisted backport of cyan, green and red agent cover colors to its community release branch. Fresh installs can now resolve @lobehub/ui 6.19.0 within the declared dependency range, avoiding type-check failures and undefined cover colors on some generated avatars.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat v2.3.5 更新代理封面色
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天框架）推出 v2.3.5，回移主分支新增的青、綠、紅代理封面色。全新安裝可避開舊七色調色板的型別錯誤及頭像缺色，減少設定受阻；同類介面亦可選 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat improves crawl recovery
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released cli-release v0.0.175, moving web-crawl error recovery into tool results. This keeps failed crawls within the tool workflow instead of requiring separate handling, making web browsing more consistent.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 優化網頁抓取錯誤復原
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）發布 v0.0.175，將網頁抓取錯誤復原移至工具結果。過往失敗要另行處理，現在可由工具結果接手，令瀏覽流程更連貫；比較部署方案可留意 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.174 released
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat framework, released CLI v0.0.174 to align community workspace dependencies and Markdown prebundling. Users of these features may see fewer dependency mismatches and more consistent setup.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI v0.0.174 發布
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天框架）發布CLI v0.0.174，對齊社群工作區依賴與Markdown預打包。用戶使用相關功能時，從前較易受依賴錯配影響，更新後設定更一致；同類可選其他開源AI前端。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Channel Notification Muting
items.summary_en: LobeChat v0.0.173 introduces channel notification muting. Users can silence less important channels to reduce interruptions and focus on alerts that matter.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 新增頻道通知靜音功能
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（AI 聊天平台）新增頻道通知靜音功能，用戶可關閉指定頻道提示，避免雜訊打斷工作。過往缺少逐頻道靜音，現在可靜音較少關注的頻道，把注意力留給重要訊息；同類選擇可留意其他聊天平台的通知設定。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Updates WebGPU GDN Support Check
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference framework, updated the WebGPU support check for GDN operations in release b12631. Users running GDN models through WebGPU get more accurate capability handling; this is a compatibility fix rather than a new feature.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp更新WebGPU的GDN檢查
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地大型語言模型推論框架）更新WebGPU的GDN支援檢查，讓程式按支援狀況處理運算。使用WebGPU跑GDN模型的用戶或可減少相容性落差；此版屬檢查修正而非新增功能，同類可比較Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Device Approval for Channel Agents
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, now lets device owners approve Channel Agents. This adds a confirmation step before agents can connect through a channel, giving users more control over access.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 為 Channel Agents 加入裝置審批
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 係開源 AI 對話平台，現可由裝置擁有者審批 Channel Agents。代理經頻道連線前多一道確認，使用戶更能掌握存取權；同类選擇包括可自建部署的聊天前端。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Adreno 850 OpenCL GEMM Support
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, added OpenCL cooperative-matrix GEMM support for the Adreno 850 GPU across six quantization formats. This gives devices with that GPU an OpenCL path for quantized matrix operations, reducing the need to rely on CPU-only processing.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp新增Adreno 850加速
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地AI模型推理工具）為Adreno 850 GPU加入OpenCL協同矩陣乘法支援，涵蓋六種量化格式。採用該GPU的裝置可讓運算走OpenCL路徑，減少只靠CPU處理；可選Vulkan後端。

items.headline_en: Detection rules and IOCs for AI agent attack frameworks: ARTEX, Cairn, PentAGI, HexStrike, CyberStrikeAI, Stri
items.summary_en: ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections - Detection rules and IOCs for AI agent attack frameworks: ARTEX, Cairn, PentAGI, HexStrike, CyberStrikeAI, Strix, Hermes Agent, Agent Zero, RedAmon, Xalgorix, Pentest Swarm AI. KQL hunts for Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR, Sigma, Suricata, Zeek, YARA, Splunk, Elastic, STIX 2.1. Gained 710 GitHub stars in 6 days (~115/day).

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Extends Vulkan Scaling to Non-Contiguous Data
items.summary_en: Release b12628 of llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, added Vulkan support for SCALE operations with non-contiguous source data. Users of the Vulkan backend can now handle this tensor layout during scaling, broadening compatibility for local inference.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 支援Vulkan非連續縮放
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地大型語言模型推論框架）的 Vulkan 後端新增 SCALE 支援，可處理非連續來源資料。以前這種資料排列未獲支援，現在使用 Vulkan 時相容範圍更廣；同類選擇亦可考慮 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Centralizes Chat Preferences
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released v0.0.169 with chat preferences consolidated into a Conversation setting. Users can now manage relevant preferences in one place instead of searching separate settings; Open WebUI is a similar platform they can also consider.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 集中管理聊天偏好
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）在v0.0.169版本把聊天偏好集中到Conversation設定。用戶現可於同一處管理相關選項，毋須再到不同設定間尋找；想比較同類選擇，也可留意Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: OpenMan Runs an Autonomous AI Agent on Orgo Cloud
items.summary_en: OpenMan is an open-source autonomous AI agent workspace that runs on an Orgo cloud computer. It gives users a cloud-hosted place to operate an agent rather than relying only on a local computer; the repository gained 113 GitHub stars in four days.
items.headline_zh: OpenMan：AI agent的雲端工作空間
items.summary_zh: OpenMan係開源自主AI agent工作空間，可在Orgo雲端電腦運行。用戶毋須只靠本地電腦，現可將agent放喺雲端操作；項目4日獲113個GitHub星標。同類選擇可比較AutoGen等框架。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp fits non-causal batches into one ubatch
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, released build b12627 with server support for fitting non-causal batches into one ubatch. For users running local or self-hosted model servers, this keeps prompt-oriented batches in a single micro-batch rather than splitting them, simplifying the processing path.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 新版支援單一 ubatch
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源大型語言模型推論框架）發布 b12627，讓伺服器可把非因果批次放進同一個 ubatch。對本地或自架模型服務的用戶而言，提示批次毋須再拆成多個微批次，流程更直接。同類選擇可看 Ollama。

items.headline_en: browser-use 1.0.8 Adds Remote Approval
items.summary_en: browser-use, an AI framework for building browser agents, released 1.0.8 with cached Judge runs, cross-device approval for SSH or headless setups, and DeepSeek and Qwen thinking-mode support. Users can avoid duplicate trace charges and approve runs from another device without placing an API key on the remote machine.
items.headline_zh: browser-use 1.0.8 支援遠端審批
items.summary_zh: browser-use（AI瀏覽器代理框架）推出1.0.8，新增Judge快取、跨裝置審批及DeepSeek、Qwen思考模式。用戶可免重複計費，在SSH或無頭環境以連結與代碼授權；同類可選BrowserGym。

items.headline_en: LobeChat releases desktop canary build
items.summary_en: LobeChat released Desktop Canary v2.3.5-canary.3, adding --visibility to CLI task creation and editing and replacing the Toby OIDC client with a dedicated lobot-mobile client. CLI users can now set task visibility in the same create-or-edit step, though canary indicates a test build rather than a stable release.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat Canary 新版發布
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）發布Desktop Canary v2.3.5-canary.3，CLI新增--visibility，可指定任務顯示範圍。建立或編輯任務時毋須另行設定；同類可選Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat v0.0.168 Replaces Toby OIDC Client
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released v0.0.168 and replaced the Toby client with a dedicated lobot-mobile client for OIDC. Users now use the dedicated client for OIDC authentication instead of Toby.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 換用 OIDC 新用戶端
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）v0.0.168把OIDC嘅Toby client換成專用lobot-mobile client。用戶OIDC登入會改用後者；亦可選支援OIDC嘅Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes Vulkan Bug
items.summary_en: llama.cpp is an open-source runtime for running large language models locally; release b12626 fixes Vulkan memset handling for unaligned ranges on non-UMA devices. Users of the Vulkan backend on these systems get more reliable memory operations when running models; Ollama is a higher-level alternative for local model setup.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 Vulkan 記憶體
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp 係開源本地大型語言模型執行工具，今次修正非 UMA 裝置上 Vulkan 對未對齊記憶體範圍的 memset 處理。過去呢類操作可能出錯，更新後可提升模型執行穩定性。簡單部署模型可考慮 Ollama。

items.headline_en: AWS Quick Adds Meta Ads AI Connector
items.summary_en: AWS Quick, a generative AI app-building service from AWS, now offers a Meta ads AI connector for natural-language campaign creation, management, and analysis. Advertisers can combine Meta ad data with first- and third-party sources to build dashboards, documents, slide decks, and automated workflows within Quick, keeping campaign work and outputs together.
items.headline_zh: AWS Quick 接入 Meta Ads AI
items.summary_zh: AWS Quick（生成式 AI 工具）新增 Meta 廣告 AI 連接器，以自然語言建、管理及分析廣告，結合 Meta、第一、三方資料製作儀表板與自動流程。由跨工具變集中處理；同類如 Meta Ads Manager。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp adds no-reasoning option
items.summary_en: llama.cpp b12624 now passes reasoning_effort=none through chat requests when supported. Previously the chat layer did not forward this setting, so users can now explicitly request no reasoning for straightforward prompts; Ollama is another local-inference option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp b12624新增關閉推理功能
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機AI推論框架）b12624版在支援時，聊天功能會傳入reasoning_effort=none。以前聊天層未會傳遞此設定，現在用戶可要求不作推理，適合簡單查詢；同類工具可選Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp fixes Parakeet OOB issue
items.summary_en: llama.cpp release b12623 merges Parakeet relative-position views in mtmd to avoid an out-of-bounds error. This lowers the risk of encountering that error for users running Parakeet workflows.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp修正Parakeet越界問題
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地開源大型語言模型框架）發布b12623，合併Parakeet相對位置視圖，避免越界錯誤。用戶在mtmd流程使用Parakeet時，可降低越界錯誤風險；同類選擇有Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Automatically Applies .scale Tensors
items.summary_en: The b12622 release of llama.cpp—an open-source framework for running large language models locally—now automatically applies .scale tensors and includes a correctness fix. Developers no longer need to handle these tensors manually, making setup simpler and reducing related errors; Ollama is a similar local-inference option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 自動套用 .scale 張量
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地模型執行框架）現可自動套用.scale tensors，並修正正確性問題。開發者毋須手動處理這些張量，設定更省事，亦能避免相關錯誤；另一本地模型工具 Ollama 也是同類選擇。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds SYCL Transpose Convolution Input Bounds
items.summary_en: llama.cpp (an open-source local LLM inference engine) release b12621 bounds input iteration for SYCL CONV_TRANSPOSE_1D kernels. Each output now reads only its designated input range while retaining the previous ascending order, giving SYCL users more controlled execution with fewer unnecessary reads.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 更新 SYCL 迭代邊界
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地推理引擎）發布 b12621，優化 SYCL 轉置卷積的輸入迭代邊界。以前迭代未受約束；現時每個輸出只讀指定區段並維持遞增次序，用戶可減少無關運算，行為更可控。同類引擎可選 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Adds Task Visibility Option
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, LobeChat’s terminal interface for managing tasks, added a --visibility option to lh task create and lh task edit in v0.0.167. Previously those commands could not set visibility; now users can specify it directly in the terminal.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 加入任務可見性選項
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（LobeChat 終端任務工具）v0.0.167 為任務建立及編輯加入 --visibility。用戶現可在終端指定任務可見性，毋須像以前般另行設定；同類工具可比較 Taskwarrior。

items.headline_en: YouTube AI Workflow Spans Storyboard, Capture, Animation
items.summary_en: youtube-ai-video-editing-system is a GitHub project offering an AI workflow for storyboarding, capture, and animation in YouTube video production. Creators can move from planning through capture to animation in one workflow rather than organize the stages separately; it gained 337 GitHub stars in two days.
items.headline_zh: YouTube AI 流程整合分鏡錄製與動畫
items.summary_zh: youtube-ai-video-editing-system 係GitHub上嘅YouTube AI剪輯流程，可完成分鏡、錄製與動畫。過往要自行串連環節，而家可由企劃做到動畫，減少工具調配；CapCut亦是剪輯選擇。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Duplex Model Support
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running large language models locally, added Kyutai/Hibiki realtime full-duplex support in release b12619 alongside long-session quality fixes. Local developers can now test smoother two-way voice interactions without assembling a separate real-time duplex workflow.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 支援即時全雙工語音
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地運行語言模型的開源工具）b12619 新增 Kyutai/Hibiki 即時全雙工支援，並修正長時間對話品質。過往需自行處理語音與回應輪替，現在可測試順暢的雙向語音互動；同類還有 Moshi。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes CLEF and Decision 2
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, released build b12625 with a fix for CLEF and vLLM Decision 2 models. The patch corrects no_realloc handling, so users no longer need workarounds for the affected configuration path.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正兩個模型的 no_realloc 處理
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源模型推理框架）發布 b12625，修正 CLEF 與 vLLM Decision 2 的 no_realloc 處理。用戶執行這些模型時可減少相關錯誤，無須自行繞過設定；部署亦可比較 vLLM。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp adds SYCL reordering
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference tool, added SYCL weight reordering for IQ4_NL and IQ4_XS. SYCL users can rely on the runtime to prepare weights in those quantized formats instead of arranging them manually.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 新增 SYCL 權重重排
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地推理工具）為 SYCL 後端新增 IQ4_NL 與 IQ4_XS 權重重排。用戶採用這兩種量化格式時，可由程式處理權重排列，毋須自行整理；同類本地推理工具可選 Ollama。

items.headline_en: SYCL Kernel
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for local large-language-model inference, added a SYCL column-blocked gated_delta_net kernel in release b12617. Developers can reuse the released implementation instead of writing the kernel themselves, making local-inference experiments easier to run in SYCL environments.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 新增 SYCL 核心
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源模型推論框架）b12617 版新增分欄 gated_delta_net 的 SYCL 核心。開發者毋須自行寫核心即可測試本地推論，降低 SYCL 整合門檻；同類比較可看 CUDA 或 Vulkan。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Fused SYCL Operations
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source library for running large language models locally, added a fused operation combining ADD, RMS_NORM and MUL, plus vectorized contiguous RMS normalization, to its SYCL backend. Developers using SYCL can combine processing steps instead of handling them separately, potentially reducing repeated work; other backends include Metal.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 為SYCL加入融合運算
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp 是本機執行語言模型的開源庫，SYCL 後端新增 ADD、RMS_NORM、MUL 融合運算，並將連續 RMS 正規化向量化。此前須分開處理，現可融合運算，有望減少重複工作；同類有 Metal 後端。

items.headline_en: MR Office Brings AI to Office Files
items.summary_en: MR Office, an open-source browser-based AI office suite, lets users edit documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and code with Copilot in each editor. Users can edit real Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without moving work between separate tools, while an MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Codex create or edit them and one-line embedding brings the suite into an app; the project gained 2,176 GitHub stars in 12 days.
items.headline_zh: MR Office 支援 AI 協作編輯檔案
items.summary_zh: MR Office 是開源瀏覽器 AI 辦公套件，可編輯檔案。Copilot 支援 Word、Excel、PowerPoint，MCP 可建立或修改內容；用戶由跨工具搬檔變為就地協作。同類可選 Microsoft 365。

items.headline_en: fast-anything Rewrites Only Slow Code
items.summary_en: fast-anything is a coding-agent workflow that profiles Python, Node, or Ruby apps, ports slow hot functions, and checks that their behavior remains the same. Developers can focus on bottlenecks instead of rewriting whole apps, replacing manual profiling and porting with agent-guided work; profilers such as Python's cProfile offer analysis without automated porting, and the project gained 1,966 GitHub stars in two days.
items.headline_zh: fast-anything只重寫慢速函式
items.summary_zh: fast-anything 是編碼代理效能工具，可分析 Python、Node 或 Ruby 應用，改寫慢速熱點並驗證行為不變。用戶毋須重寫全專案，過往要自行找瓶頸及移植，現在可交代理處理；只分析可用 cProfile。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM v1.108.15 Released
items.summary_en: LiteLLM v1.108.15 backports a test for the Responses API and documents Docker image signature verification with cosign. Users can now follow the documented process to check image authenticity before deployment.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM v1.108.15 發布
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM 是統一管理多種大模型 API 的開源工具。v1.108.15 回移 Responses API 測試，並說明以 cosign 驗證 Docker 映像簽署；用戶現可按官方流程核對映像來源，提升部署可信度。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM Adds Proxy Header Control
items.summary_en: LiteLLM, an open-source AI model API gateway, lets proxy operators omit x-litellm-* response headers in v1.112.0-dev.2 and documents a cosign command for verifying its Docker image. Teams can tailor proxy output instead of returning every header and verify the image before deployment.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM 支援省略 Proxy 回應標頭
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM（開源 AI 模型 API 閘道）新增省略 x-litellm-* 回應標頭功能。用家過往無法移除該標頭，現可按需要清理代理輸出，令回應更貼合介面要求；同類可選 Portkey AI 閘道。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp works around AMD Windows Vulkan bug
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local inference framework, released b12613 to work around an AMD Windows Vulkan driver bug by unrolling the FA coopmat1 array and simplifying the code. Users on the affected setup may see fewer Flash Attention failures.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 繞過 AMD 驅動錯誤
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地推論框架）發布b12613，Vulkan版改用展開FA陣列，避開AMD Windows驅動錯誤並簡化程式碼。相關用戶以前或會在FA操作時出錯，現版本則有望避開；同類整合方案可比較Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp speeds up RDNA4 MMVQ
items.summary_en: The b12612 release of llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, improves Vulkan MMVQ performance for Q3_K, Q5_K, and IQ4_XS on RDNA4 while preserving default MMVQ rows on AMD's proprietary driver. RDNA4 users may see quicker local inference; Ollama is a similar alternative.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 優化 RDNA4 推論效能
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機推論框架）改善Vulkan在AMD RDNA4的MMVQ表現，涵蓋Q3_K、Q5_K及IQ4_XS。RDNA4用戶毋須改動專有驅動程式預設值，本機推論可望更快；同類工具亦可選Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp fixes NVFP4 expert scales
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running language models locally, released b12611 with a post-scale hook that shares inkling2_loop's loop slots after optional scale tensors are attached. The change prevents later core passes from running NVFP4 experts without their per-expert scales, helping local quantized inference process those experts correctly.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp修正NVFP4專家scale
