items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地跑語言模型的開源框架）修正inkling2_loop在scale後共用loop slots的時機，令NVFP4專家取得scale。用戶跑量化模型時，本地推論可正確處理scale；同類如vLLM。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.166 fixes PATH detection
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released CLI v0.0.166 with a fix for launching CLI agents and dsh through PATH detection validation. Users who previously had to inspect PATH settings manually can rely on the release's improved validation instead.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI修正路徑偵測
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）發布CLI修正版，修正CLI agents與dsh啟動時的路徑偵測驗證。以往工具未被辨識時，用戶要自行檢查PATH設定，現在可由新版處理；同類工作可比較Claude Code。

items.headline_en: OpenRouter Adds Changelog Entry
items.summary_en: OpenRouter added a changelog entry dated November 21, 2026, but the provided information does not specify any new features or fixes.
items.headline_zh: OpenRouter新增11月21日變更紀錄

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.165 Updates SDK
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat framework, released CLI v0.0.165, adding readable operationIds plus SDK support for scopes, workspaces, retries, and typed features. Developers can now identify and trace integration operations more clearly and configure workspace and retry behavior.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 更新 SDK 能力
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 為開源 AI 聊天框架，CLI v0.0.165 更新 SDK，新增易讀操作 ID、權限、工作區、重試與型別支援。過往整合操作較難辨識，現時可清晰追蹤並配置工作區與重試；同類選擇有 Chatbox。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI expands Antigravity controls
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.164 adds model and effort-level selection for Antigravity, plus FullAccess support. Users can tailor model behavior and access settings instead of relying only on defaults.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat新增Antigravity控制項
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）嘅CLI推出v0.0.164，在Antigravity加入模型及推理強度選擇，並支援FullAccess。用戶可按需要調整模型與權限，毋須只沿用預設。同類選擇有Claude Code。

items.headline_en: ggml improves memory access
items.summary_en: Release b12620 improves ggml’s memory-access pattern in a `ggml_compute_for…` function. The change may improve efficiency for users running models locally.
items.headline_zh: ggml 改善記憶體存取模式
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（可在本機執行大型語言模型的開源框架）發布 b12620，改進 ggml 計算的記憶體存取模式。相關運算效率有望提升，讓本地模型執行更順暢；同類選擇可看 Ollama。

items.headline_en: Open-source, local-first AI agent team for your desktop: multi-agent group chats, computer use, browser, MCP,
items.summary_en: w01fb0ss/PiBot - Open-source, local-first AI agent team for your desktop: multi-agent group chats, computer use, browser, MCP, routines and approvals. macOS, Windows, Linux + Android. Built on pi. Gained 604 GitHub stars in 5 days (~124/day).

items.headline_en: LobeChat adds Flare and Sunburst to its model bank
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat workspace, added GPT Image 2.6 Flare and Sunburst to its model bank in release v0.0.163. Users can now choose from more image-generation options in one place instead of sourcing models separately.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 模型庫新增兩款圖像模型
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 這款開源 AI 聊天工作台在 v0.0.163 為模型庫加入 GPT Image 2.6 Flare 和 Sunburst，用戶現可多選圖像生成方案，毋須另找模型；同類可選 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: Transformers Adds Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_en: Transformers, the open-source model library, added Inkling 2 Mini in v5.24.0; the smaller model from Thinking Machines Lab accepts text and image inputs and generates text. Users can now access a compact multimodal option through the library without separate integration, while Inkling 2 Small remains the larger sibling.
items.headline_zh: Inkling 2 Mini 納入模型庫
items.summary_zh: Transformers（模型工具庫）v5.24.0 新增 Inkling 2 Mini，這款多模態模型可接收文字與圖片並輸出文字。用戶毋須再自行另找整合，可選用較小版本；同系另有較大的 Inkling 2 Small。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp CUDA Update Aborts on Undefined Behavior
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, released b12614 with a CUDA change that aborts when a fastdiv operation encounters undefined behavior. For users running inference on NVIDIA GPUs, this makes such faults surface earlier instead of allowing potentially invalid computation to continue; Ollama is a similar alternative.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp CUDA 更新中止未定義行為
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地跑語言模型的開源框架）發布新版，CUDA 在 fastdiv 出現未定義行為時會中止。以前用戶推理遇到這種情況可能仍繼續運算，現在能較早察覺錯誤，避免可能無效的結果繼續產生；同類選擇有 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp fixes ztensor loading race condition
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running large language models locally, fixed a race condition in ggml-zdnn's ztensor loading path. The fix is intended to reduce intermittent failures in affected local inference runs.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修復 ztensor 競態
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（可在本機運行 AI 模型的开源工具）修復 ggml-zdnn 加載 ztensor 時的競態問題，受影響的推理由偶發失敗變得更穩定；同類選擇可比較其他 ggml backend。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes PPC Multiplication Error
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source AI inference tool, has released b12608 with a fix for a PPC alignment bug in ggml-cpu's tinyBLAS_Q0 kernel. Previously, nc=4 could select a tiled path despite the kernel's multiple-of-8 alignment requirement, causing incorrect matrix multiplication results, so PPC users can now avoid those faulty calculations; ONNX Runtime is another inference option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 PPC 矩陣運算錯誤
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（AI推論工具）以b12608修正ggml-cpu的tinyBLAS_Q0於PPC對齊錯誤。過往nc=4可誤入tiled路徑，導致錯誤結果；PPC用戶現可避免此問題。同類可選ONNX Runtime。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Fixes Agent Activation
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, an AI agent command-line tool, released v0.0.162, completing a migration to two-state activation for tools and skills. Users can now apply the same activation setup to both, making it easier to control which agent capabilities are active.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 完成啟用機制遷移
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（AI agent 命令列工具）發布 v0.0.162，完成工具及技能雙態啟用機制遷移。以前沿用舊制，現時可統一設定兩者是否啟用，讓操作更一致；同類選擇可看 Claude Code。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Always Uses Fused Lightning Indexer
items.summary_en: Release b12606 of llama.cpp, the open-source inference engine for local models, removes gating around the fused Lightning indexer and drops its related flags, auto-probe, and non-fused fallbacks. Users no longer need to probe or select separate indexer paths, simplifying setup; Ollama is another option for local-model use.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp取消Indexer模式切換
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp 是開源本地模型推論引擎；b12606 版移除融合 Lightning Indexer 的切換閘門，現時一律採用融合路徑。用戶毋須再手動探測或選擇索引器模式，設定更簡單；同類工具可選 Ollama。

items.headline_en: Whiteboard AI Tutor Is Open-Source
items.summary_en: The open-source Whiteboard AI Tutor creates animated lessons with interactive playback; its model comparison covers 288 generation runs and 64 blind-reviewed boards. Learners can follow lessons through animation and playback controls instead of text alone; comparable models include Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek.
items.headline_zh: Whiteboard AI Tutor提供動畫課堂
items.summary_zh: Whiteboard AI Tutor係開源白板AI家教，提供動畫課堂與互動播放，並以288次生成、64塊盲評白板比較Claude、Gemini與DeepSeek。學生可睇動畫並播放，毋須只靠文字。亦可比較Claude

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Updates Marketplace
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.161 updates the marketplace to organize app capabilities and separate MCP-related items. The clearer structure helps users browse and manage marketplace features with less confusion.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 更新市集功能
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天框架）CLI 發布 v0.0.161，更新市集以整理應用能力，並分開 MCP 項目。以前使用者要自行分辨應用能力與 MCP 內容，現在可更清楚瀏覽及管理功能。同類選擇有 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: Cline v4.1.27 adds LM Studio API keys and read-only MCP badges
items.summary_en: Cline, an AI coding extension, released v4.1.27 with an API-key field for LM Studio servers that require authentication, read-only badges for MCP tools, and a link to web-app privacy settings. Users can now supply the required key, identify read-only tools at a glance, and reach data-use preferences from Account view; the package also includes third-party license notices.
items.headline_zh: Cline v4.1.27 加入金鑰與唯讀標記
items.summary_zh: Cline（AI 程式開發擴充套件）為需驗證的 LM Studio 伺服器加入 API 金鑰欄位，並在 MCP 分頁標示唯讀工具。用戶過往需另設認證，現可直接設定及辨識權限；私隱偏好亦有入口，同類有 Roo Code。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes Grammar Integer Overflow
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running AI models locally, fixed an integer overflow in llama-grammar. The parser now checks invalid integer values and exits gracefully, so users get safer handling of malformed grammar inputs.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp grammar 修復整數溢位
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地 AI 推論工具）嘅 llama-grammar 修復整數溢位，解析時會檢查錯誤值並妥善中止。用戶遇到異常 grammar 時，以前可能觸發溢位，而家可妥善停下；同類可選其他有防溢位檢查嘅解析器。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Limits QSA Scoring to k-Pools
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference tool, released b12603, which limits QSA scoring to the k-pools of ubatch sequences. For users, this is an internal efficiency change rather than a new feature, with no benchmark data provided.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp QSA 縮小評分範圍
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機推論工具）版本 b12603 將 QSA 改為只評分 ubatch 序列的 k-pools，縮減分數計算。對用戶而言，這是底層效率調整，未見新功能或效能數據；同類工具另有 Ollama。

items.headline_en: Cline SDK v0.2.1 preserves full file reads
items.summary_en: Cline, an AI coding agent, released SDK v0.2.1 with revised tool-output limits. Read_files output now follows the 50,000-token file-content cap and reaches the provider intact instead of being recut to the 8,000-token tool-result cap, so large files can supply more context; command, search, MCP and custom tool results keep the 8,000-token cap.
items.headline_zh: Cline SDK v0.2.1 完整讀取檔案
items.summary_zh: Cline（AI編碼代理）發布SDK v0.2.1，read_files結果按50k檔案內容上限完整送達模型，不再重切至8k上限。以前大型檔案或會截斷，內容可完整保留；其他工具限8k。同類代理如Claude Code。

items.headline_en: Cline UI SDK v0.2.1
items.summary_en: Cline’s UI SDK, a toolkit for developers building interfaces, released v0.2.1. Developers can move from the previous package version to this patch release, although the supplied note lists no feature changes.
items.headline_zh: Cline UI SDK推出v0.2.1
items.summary_zh: Cline（開源AI程式代理）的UI SDK是供開發者打造介面的工具套件，現推出v0.2.1。用戶毋須繼續沿用舊版，可轉用這個修補版本；但今次資料未列明功能差異。同類選擇可比較React等通用元件庫。

items.headline_en: Cline Core v0.2.1 Released
items.summary_en: Cline released @cline/core version 0.2.1. Developers can update the package, though the release note gives no feature details or stated upgrade benefit.
items.headline_zh: Cline核心套件推出0.2.1版
items.summary_zh: Cline（開源AI程式開發代理）的核心套件@cline/core推出0.2.1版。沿用舊版的開發者現可更新套件；但今次資料只列出版本，未交代新增功能或修正，暫時難判斷實際升級效益。同類選擇包括Cursor。

items.headline_en: Cline Releases @cline/llms v0.2.1
items.summary_en: Cline, an open-source AI coding agent for VS Code, released version 0.2.1 of its @cline/llms package.

items.summary_zh: Cline（AI 程式編碼代理）發布 @cline/llms 套件 0.2.1。開發者過往要沿用舊版，現可更新依賴取得新版內容；惟公布資料未列明功能或修正。模型整合工具的同類選擇可比較 LangChain。

items.headline_en: Cline Releases Shared SDK v0.2.1
items.summary_en: Cline, an open-source AI coding assistant, has released @cline/shared v0.2.1, a shared package for its SDK. Developers can move from the older package to the new version, although no specific changes are listed.
items.headline_zh: Cline共享SDK發布v0.2.1
items.summary_zh: Cline 是開源 AI 程式設計助理；Cline SDK 的共享套件 @cline/shared 發布 v0.2.1，讓工具鏈共用元件。開發者可由舊版轉用新版，惟未列變更，效益待確認。同類選擇如 Claude Code

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Shareable Agent Cards
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, now lets users share an Agent as a card without opening its link. Users can share an Agent more directly instead of first opening its link.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 新增 Agent 分享卡
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）新增 Agent 分享卡，讓用戶毋須開啟 Agent 連結，也可直接以卡片形式分享。分享給別人時毋須繞到連結頁，操作更直接。同類選擇可用 ChatGPT 的 GPT 分享連結。

items.headline_en: Ollama Releases Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_en: Ollama (a local AI model runner) released Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini in v0.40.17, a 26B-parameter model with 5.4B active parameters and looped layers. It supports text, images, tool calls, and thinking while fitting on a Mac with about 20GB of memory, letting users run multimodal tool-using work locally instead of relying on a separate cloud service; LM Studio is a similar option.
items.headline_zh: Ollama 發布 Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_zh: Ollama（本地模型執行器）推出 Inkling 2 Mini，支援文字、圖片、工具呼叫與思考，26B模型僅啟用5.4B參數。約20GB記憶體的Mac已可本機執行，不依賴雲端服務；同類可選LM Studio。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Improves SYCL GEMM
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source library for running large language models locally, released b12602 with a SYCL backend improvement. The grouped XMX GEMM path now avoids SLM staging, potentially making matrix operations more efficient for users on supported SYCL hardware.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 優化SYCL矩陣運算
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本機運行大型語言模型的開源工具）發布b12602，SYCL分組XMX GEMM可避開SLM暫存。過往矩陣運算需經暫存，現在可省去該步驟，兼容SYCL硬體的用戶可望提升效率；同類方案亦可選Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Fixes Thread Continuation
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.159 fixes channel handling so an earlier thread is continued only in the agent’s own case. For users, the narrower condition helps prevent unrelated context from being carried into follow-up conversations.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正對話接續
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（命令列工具）發布v0.0.159，修復 channel 的 thread 接續，調整 AI 代理延續舊 thread 的條件。以前或會接錯脈絡，現在較不易混入無關紀錄；同類可選其他AI CLI。

items.headline_en: Quick update
items.summary_en: AWS Quick, an AI workspace built only for work, released updates for chat-based business-process flows, a refreshed web app, more complete multi-agent answers, and Meta ads and Amplitude data connections. Users can now build and run processes, triage daily work, and get multi-agent answers in one workspace instead of handling each task separately; Glean is a comparable option.
items.headline_zh: AWS Quick 更新多代理與工作流程
items.summary_zh: AWS Quick（工作專用 AI 空間）現可於聊天建立及運行業務流程、以新版網頁分流日常事項、取得多代理回覆，並連接 Meta ads、Amplitude。用戶由逐項處理變為集中處理工作；同類亦可選 Glean。

items.headline_en: AWS Adds Distributed KV Cache Skill
items.summary_en: The Agent Toolkit for AWS includes a distributed KV caching skill that lets a coding agent evaluate and set up the cache in Amazon ElastiCache. For self-hosted LLMs, reusing cached context instead of recomputing it on every turn can cut inference costs by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%.
items.headline_zh: AWS 加入分散式 KV 快取技能
items.summary_zh: Agent Toolkit for AWS 的分散式 KV 快取可設定 Amazon ElastiCache，讓自架 LLM 重用 context。過往重算，現減推論成本最多 40%、首字延遲最多 80%；同類工具亦可選

items.headline_en: Qwen4 Max is live
items.summary_en: Qwen4 Max, Alibaba's flagship Qwen model, is now available on Together AI, with 30% off through November 22, 2026. Developers can submit a bug report and an entire repository in one request; in the test, its patch passed project tests at a cost of 69 cents, offering a shorter path from report to tested fix.
items.headline_zh: Qwen4 Max 上架 Together AI
items.summary_zh: Qwen4 Max 是阿里巴巴旗艦 AI 模型，已登陸 Together AI。用戶可一次提交錯誤報告及整個程式庫，生成修補通過測試，只花 69 美分；過往要自行拆解，現可交模型處理。同類可選其他 Qwen 型號。

items.headline_en: Together AI Discloses Prompt Leak
items.summary_en: Together AI, a platform for serverless AI inference, disclosed that a security incident involving a subset of prompts submitted to its service occurred in June and July 2026. Customers who used the service during those months can now learn from the notice that their prompts may have been exposed, rather than relying on guesswork.
items.headline_zh: Together AI 公布提示外洩事故
items.summary_zh: Together AI（提供模型無伺服器推理的平台）披露，其服務在2026年6月及7月收到的部分提示涉及外洩事故。用戶毋須自行猜測風險，現可從官方通知知悉提交內容可能受影響；同類平台亦可考慮 Fireworks AI。

items.summary_en: Antialgorithm is a GitHub agent skill that steers AI models away from their first, most average pick in creative work such as naming, ideas, logos, posters and UI. This encourages less generic alternatives, helping users avoid settling on the initial result; the repository gained 604 GitHub stars in eight days.
items.headline_zh: Antialgorithm 避開 AI 平庸首選
items.summary_zh: Antialgorithm（AI Agent 技能）可引導模型避開創意任務中最平庸的首選，支援命名、構想、Logo、海報和 UI。以前 AI 或先給平均答案，現在可促使模型探索其他方向。同類選擇還有創意提示模板。

items.summary_en: replit/amuse - Self-hosted personal AI agent: research, a live browser, reminders and small apps, with approvals before actions. Runs on your own computer with an OpenAI key. Gained 152 GitHub stars in 5 days (~30/day).

items.headline_en: 格知 AI · Gezhi Sheets｜让表格听懂你的话。支持 GLM、Kimi、豆包、DeepSeek、Qwen 的本地 AI 表格助手。

items.summary_en: TraxAgent is a read-only MCP server and Claude Code plugin that answers where your AI budget went and what to fix. Users can ask Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code directly instead of manually tracing usage.
items.headline_zh: TraxAgent 查 AI 預算去向
items.summary_zh: TraxAgent 是唯讀 MCP 伺服器兼 Claude Code 外掛，可查 AI 預算花費及改善方法。用戶毋須逐項核對用量，現可向 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 等工具直接查問；比較成本亦可參考 AI 用量分析工具。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM 1.108.14 LTS release
items.summary_en: LiteLLM, a gateway for standardized access to language-model APIs, released version 1.108.14 as an LTS build. Users can pull the lts tag for the newest LTS patch without manually tracking each version, pin v1.108.14 when needed, and verify either image with the provided Cosign command.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM 發布 1.108.14 LTS
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM（統一模型API的閘道）推出1.108.14 LTS。用戶以前要自行查最新LTS修補，現可拉取lts映像取得新版，並以Cosign驗證來源；想鎖定版本則可選v1.108.14映像

items.headline_en: Ollama adds Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_en: Inkling 2 Mini, a 26B-parameter model with 5.4B active parameters from Thinking Machines, is now available to run in Ollama. It handles text and images, tool calls, and thinking while fitting on a Mac with about 20GB of memory, letting users run a multimodal model locally rather than needing a larger setup.
items.headline_zh: Ollama 加入 Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_zh: Ollama 現可執行 Inkling 2 Mini；模型有 26B 參數、啟用 5.4B，支援文字、圖像、工具呼叫與思考。用戶過往較難本機運行，約 20GB 記憶體的 Mac 可處理，工作可留在本機。同類可選Qwen。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM runtime, adds Inkling 2 Mini conversion support in b12600, including gate_rank-based metadata builds and loop-graph handling. Users can test and build the model in one workflow, reducing separate conversion work; Ollama is a similar local-inference option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp支援Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地推論工具）加入 Inkling 2 Mini 轉換，並新增 gate_rank 建置及 loop graph 處理。以前要另做轉換，而家可測試同建置模型，減少整合工作；可比較 Ollama。

items.headline_en: Rust 0.173 Alpha 4 Released
items.summary_en: Rust, a systems programming language, has released v0.173.0-alpha.4 as an early build in its 0.173.0 series. The notice provides no feature or fix details, so users should check compatibility before upgrading instead of expecting a specific benefit.
items.headline_zh: Rust 發布 v0.173.0-alpha.4
items.summary_zh: Rust（系統程式語言）發布 v0.173.0-alpha.4 測試版，屬 0.173.0 系列早期版本；公告未列功能或修正。過往升級前要查改動，今次宜先核對相容性，未見明確收益毋須急升級；偏好穩定者可選 Rust 穩定版。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds RDNA1 MMVQ Parameters
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference tool, added a dedicated MMVQ parameter table for AMD's RDNA1 GPU architecture in its HIP backend. HIP builds now use explicit RDNA1-specific values instead of recursively deriving them from the generic table; no performance results are provided.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp新增RDNA1 MMVQ參數
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地 AI 推論工具）為 AMD RDNA1 的 HIP 版本加入專用 MMVQ 參數表，明確寫入相關數值。RDNA1 用戶過往要靠泛用表遞迴取得參數，現可直接使用針對該架構的明示設定；本次更新未附效能數據。同類本地 AI 工具亦可考慮 Ollama。

items.headline_en: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Adds Managed Slurm Extensions
items.summary_en: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, an AWS-managed service for AI clusters, now offers extensions for observability and user management, with declarative API- and console-driven configuration for software running on Slurm cluster nodes. Platform teams can manage shared Slurm clusters centrally instead of maintaining these settings manually across nodes.
items.headline_zh: SageMaker HyperPod新增受管擴充
items.summary_zh: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod（AWS的大型AI叢集管理服務）新增受管叢集擴充，可透過API或主控台宣告式設定Slurm節點軟件的可觀測性與用戶管理。平台團隊以往要自行維護相關設定，現在可集中管理共享叢集，減少重複操作；需要更深度自訂時，也可直接採用原生Slurm。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Aligns Qwen3-ASR Conversion with Testing
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source AI inference tool, updates its Qwen3-ASR converter in b12597 to put “language …” output into the thinking block and read the chat template from models/templates. This replaces the converter’s embedded Qwen3-ASR.jinja copy, so GGUF conversion and test-chat share one template and stay aligned; Kimi-K3 and Kokoro converters already use the bundled-file approach.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp改用Qwen3-ASR共用模板
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（推論工具）的Qwen3-ASR轉換器改讀共用聊天模板，並把language輸出移入思考區。過往內嵌模板副本，現時GGUF與測試聊天共用同一模板，兩邊更一致；Kimi-K3、Kokoro亦採同法。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Metal expands fused norm-chain support
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, now lets its Metal backend place norm chains in either operand of fused MUL/ADD operations. Apple-platform developers gain more flexible kernel layouts for combining normalization with arithmetic instead of being limited to one operand position.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp Metal 支援任一邊正規化鏈
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地 LLM 推論框架）的 Metal 後端，現可把正規化鏈置於融合乘法加法的任一操作數。過往位置受限，Apple 平台開發者如今可更靈活組合正規化與算術；同類方案亦可比較 Ollama。

items.headline_en: Browser Use 1.0.8rc1 adds remote API approval
items.summary_en: Browser Use, an open-source framework for AI agents to operate browsers, published the 1.0.8rc1 release candidate. Users can avoid repeat charges when judges request another turn by reusing cached runs, and approve API-key access from another device in SSH or headless setups via a link and code.
items.headline_zh: Browser Use 測試版支援跨裝置授權
items.summary_zh: Browser Use（AI 瀏覽器代理工具）推出測試候選版。評審追問可讀快取，免再付費；SSH 或無頭環境可輸出連結與代碼，讓你在另一裝置批准 API key，無需把金鑰放進遠端機器。固定流程可選 Playwright。

items.headline_en: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Adds Global Inference Gateway
items.summary_en: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, an AWS machine-learning infrastructure product, has added Global Inference Gateway, a single managed endpoint that routes inference requests across HyperPod clusters in one Region or across Regions. It selects the best cluster, fails over automatically, and authenticates every request with SigV4 and IAM over AWS PrivateLink, so teams can manage distributed inference routing and resilience through one endpoint.
items.headline_zh: HyperPod推出全球推理閘道
items.summary_zh: SageMaker HyperPod（AI基建）新增Global Inference Gateway，可經一端點路由同區或跨區叢集，自動選叢集及故障轉移。用戶減省維護多叢集路由容錯；亦可選Amazon Bedrock。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds ggml Version Bump Reminders
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference framework, released build b12591 with reminders for major ggml version bumps and deprecated the ggml_ftype field. The supplied attestations also cover listed macOS, iOS, and Linux builds, helping developers verify artifacts and address compatibility changes earlier.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp新增ggml版本升級提醒
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地AI推論框架）發布b12591，為ggml重大版本升級加入提醒，並將ggml_ftype標記為棄用；附跨平台建置證明。過往要自行追蹤，現可提早處理相容問題、查核產物；同類工具可選Ollama。

items.headline_en: Codex releases 0.173.0-alpha.3
items.summary_en: Codex, an AI coding agent, released the 0.173.0-alpha.3 build, with no feature details provided.
items.headline_zh: Codex 推出 0.173.0-alpha.3
items.summary_zh: Codex（AI 編碼代理）推出 0.173.0-alpha.3 測試版，但未交代新增功能，暫時未見明確使用優勢。開發者可查看版本紀錄；重視穩定者可先等正式版，同類選擇有 Cursor、GitHub Copilot。

items.headline_en: OpenRouter Adds Date-Only Changelog Entry
items.summary_en: OpenRouter, an AI model routing platform, added a changelog entry dated November 20, 2026, but the provided text contains no details about the changes.
items.headline_zh: OpenRouter 更新紀錄僅列日期
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter（AI 模型路由平台）新增 2026 年 11 月 20 日更新紀錄，但內容只列日期，未交代具體改動。用戶可按日期定位最新紀錄，毋須逐項翻查；具體影響仍須看官方正文。同類選擇可留意 LiteLLM 更新。

items.headline_en: ComfyUI Releases v0.46.2
items.summary_en: ComfyUI, an open-source node-based generative AI workflow tool, released v0.46.2 for building and running image-generation workflows.
items.headline_zh: ComfyUI發布v0.46.2新版
items.summary_zh: ComfyUI（開源節點式生成式AI工作流程工具）發布v0.46.2，讓用戶以節點連接並執行圖像生成流程；過往使用舊版者，現在可更新至新版環境，具體改進須查看更新說明。同類工具可考慮Automatic1111。

items.headline_en: Codex Releases 0.173.0-alpha.2
items.summary_en: Codex, OpenAI's AI coding agent, released prerelease build 0.173.0-alpha.2, but no feature details were provided.
items.headline_zh: Codex 發布 0.173.0-alpha.2
items.summary_zh: Codex（OpenAI 的 AI 編程代理）發布 0.173.0-alpha.2 測試版，但內容未列功能變更。以前要靠功能說明才知改進，而家這則公告只能確認新版已發布；亦可比較 GitHub Copilot 等同類工具。

items.headline_en: Standard Bank Streamlines AI Risk Reviews
items.summary_en: Standard Bank Group has automated evidence gathering for generative AI approval gates, scoring each use case against international standards and internal policies with an LLM-as-a-judge assessment on Amazon Bedrock. Risk committees can now rely on consistent, traceable evidence instead of assembling it manually.
items.headline_zh: Standard Bank以AI加快風險審批
items.summary_zh: Standard Bank Group是與AWS合作的銀行，現以Amazon Bedrock評分各生成式AI用例是否符合國際標準及內部政策，自動整理審批證據。風險委員會毋須再手工彙集資料，可取得一致且可追溯的審核依據。

items.headline_en: Amazon Textract Insights adds verifiable document extraction
items.summary_en: Amazon Textract Insights is a generally available generative AI feature of Amazon Textract, the AWS service for extracting information from documents. Users can describe needed fields in natural language, submit a document or mixed packet, and receive structured results with a confidence score and page-level source grounding for each value, making review easier without model training.
items.headline_zh: Amazon Textract 新推生成式AI
items.summary_zh: Amazon Textract 是 AWS 的文件 AI 服務；新功能 Textract Insights 可按自然語言描述欄位，為文件或混合文件包輸出附信心分數及逐頁來源定位的結構化結果。對比過往要預先訓練模型的方案，用戶現在毋須準備訓練資料或訓練模型，便能逐項核對每個值，節省設定與覆核時間；另可比較 Google Cloud Document AI。

items.headline_en: Timeout fix
items.summary_en: browser-use, an AI browser-automation framework, released version 1.0.7 with revised MCP-call handling. Long browser_exec calls now return partial output within 50 seconds instead of timing out at 60 seconds in Cursor and similar clients, while execution continues and another empty-code call retrieves the rest.
items.headline_zh: browser-use 1.0.7修正長操作逾時
items.summary_zh: browser-use 是讓 AI 代理操控瀏覽器的框架；1.0.7 令長時間操作在 50 秒內回傳輸出，避開過往 60 秒逾時，工作仍繼續。Cursor 等客戶端可再呼叫取回餘下結果；同類也可選 Playwright。

items.headline_en: OpenHands v1.43.0 Adds Automations and Experimental Tools
items.summary_en: OpenHands, an open-source AI coding agent, released v1.43.0 with setup-wizard automations and experimental interface features. Users can create automations during setup and try conversation reactions, decision cards, and agent message-edit displays, making it easier to configure and evaluate new agent features.
items.headline_zh: OpenHands v1.43.0 加入自動化與實驗功能
items.summary_zh: OpenHands（開源AI程式代理）推出v1.43.0，可從設定精靈建立自動化，並提供對話反應、決策卡及顯示代理訊息修訂等實驗功能。用戶現可在設定時啟動自動化，更易試用及評估代理功能；同類選擇有Claude Code。

items.headline_en: Ollama Adds Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_en: Ollama, a local AI model runner, adds Inkling 2 Mini support to mlxrunner in v0.40.17-rc3. Compatible users can now run the Mini model locally without setting up runner integration separately; LM Studio is a similar local-model option.
items.headline_zh: Ollama 支援 Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_zh: Ollama（本地 AI 模型工具）的 mlxrunner 新增 Inkling 2 Mini 支援。對相容用戶而言，毋須另行處理 runner 整合，現可透過 Ollama 在本機執行；同類可選 LM Studio。

items.headline_en: SageMaker HyperPod Adds Observability
items.summary_en: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, a managed compute environment for large-scale AI training, now offers enhanced observability. It combines diagnostics and profiling for Amazon EKS and Slurm workloads, helping teams pinpoint problems across GPU, network, and host layers faster.
items.headline_zh: SageMaker HyperPod 強化診斷
items.summary_zh: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod 是 AI 訓練託管環境，新增診斷與效能分析，涵蓋 GPU、網絡及主機層。用戶過往要整合多處訊號排查故障，現可更快定位瓶頸；同類選擇可考慮 Prometheus。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Fixes Agent Card Names
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.158 updates Agent contact cards to use each Agent’s personal name. The change makes the cards easier for users to recognize when working with multiple Agents.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正 Agent 卡片命名
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 對話平台）嘅 CLI 版本發布 v0.0.158，Agent 聯絡卡改用個人名稱。以前卡片名稱可能較籠統，而家更容易辨認同一 Agent；想試同類方案，可考慮其他開源 AI 對話平台。

items.headline_en: Mistral Pricing Page No Longer Shows Two Price Points
items.summary_en: Mistral, an AI model provider, has changed the price points displayed on its pricing page. Users should verify the exact plan cost before paying, since the $15 and $25.5 price points are no longer shown.
items.headline_zh: Mistral 定價頁兩個價格點消失
items.summary_zh: Mistral（供應 AI 模型嘅服務商）定價頁有變，$15 同 $25.5 兩個價格點已唔見。用戶而家付款前要重新核對方案收費，唔好再直接跟舊頁面預算；同類選擇如 OpenAI。

items.headline_en: Open WebUI Private AI Desk Brings Local AI Chat
items.summary_en: Open WebUI Private AI Desk is a GitHub tool for chatting with private AI models locally. It lets users keep conversations on their own setup rather than sending them to a hosted chatbot; the project gained 153 GitHub stars in one day.
items.headline_zh: Private AI Desk本機AI對話
items.summary_zh: Open WebUI Private AI Desk是本機AI聊天工具，讓用戶在本機與私隱模型對話。過往用雲端聊天需把內容送往遠端，現在可留在本機處理；同類可看其他本機AI工具，一日獲153個GitHub stars。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp fixes TTS thread control
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source inference tool, now passes its thread setting into the multimodal text-to-speech context. Users can control TTS CPU usage with -t instead of that stage always using four threads, while omitting -t follows the resolved default.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 TTS 執行緒控制
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源推論工具）現會把執行緒設定傳至 TTS（文字轉語音）上下文。過往 llama-tts 的 -t 對此無效，TTS 固定用四線程；現可按 CPU 資源調整，未指定則沿用預設值。mtmd-cli 亦支援。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Unifies Tasks and Goals
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat and agent platform, unified tasks and goals across agent and personal navigation in v0.0.157. Users can move between the two through a more consistent interface, reducing the need to switch between separate areas.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 統一任務與目標導覽
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 是開源 AI 聊天與代理平台；v0.0.157 將代理與個人導覽中的任務及目標整合。用戶毋須再於不同入口來回切換，整理及查找工作項目時更一致。同類平台亦可選 ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp adds private URL access option
items.summary_en: llama.cpp release b12580 adds the server option --ui-mcp-proxy-allow-private-urls for permitting private URLs through the UI MCP proxy. Server users can now explicitly allow these URLs when their setup requires access to private-network services.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 新增私網 URL 代理選項
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地模型推理工具）發布 b12580，伺服器新增私網 URL 放行選項，讓 UI 的 MCP 代理可存取私網位址。以往代理欠此明確設定，現可按內部服務需要啟用；同類可選其他支援 MCP 的本地推理框架。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp refreshes CUDA GDN support check
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running models locally, updated the CUDA support check for GDN operations. CUDA users can now rely on the refreshed check when determining whether those operations are available.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 更新 CUDA GDN 支援檢查
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（可在本機運行開源模型的開源軟件）更新 CUDA 的 GDN 支援檢查，讓程式判斷相關運算是否可用。配置 CUDA 的用戶可按更新後的結果處理 GDN 工作負載；想用較易上手介面亦可試 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Merged MoE Scale Loading
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference framework, released b12577 to load per-expert scales from merged ffn_gate_up_exps tensors and expose them as ffn_up_exps_s when no separate up tensor exists. This lets affected mixture-of-experts model loads apply the intended scaling through the merged feed-forward path.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 新增合併 MoE 縮放載入
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地大型語言模型推論框架）b12577 新增混合專家（MoE）模型合併張量的縮放值載入；模型層若沒有獨立 up 張量，也能套用縮放。用戶毋須再為合併路徑另處理 up 張量；同類選擇有 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Moves Rotation Into Models
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local model inference framework, moved lightning indexer key rotation into its model classes. The KV cache can now follow each model’s declared setting instead of a separate architecture list, preserving the intended behavior of DeepSeek 4.1; Ollama is another local-inference option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 改由模型類別控制旋轉
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地模型推論框架）把閃電索引器金鑰旋轉移入模型類別，讓KV快取按各模型聲明設定運作。用戶毋須依賴中央架構清單，DeepSeek 4.1的預期行為亦獲保留；想簡化本地推論可選Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI takes trashed task shares offline
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, the command-line tool for the open-source AI platform, released v0.0.156 with an artboard fix that takes a trashed task’s shares offline. Users can now avoid leaving shared content online after removing a task.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正刪除後分享下線
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（開源 AI 指令列工具）v0.0.156 修復 artboard 分享處理。過去任務移至垃圾桶後，分享可能仍留在線上；現在分享會自動下線，減少殘留與誤用。同類可選 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp fixes MoE cache graph overflow
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source LLM inference tool, now reserves graph nodes for its MoE cache. The change prevents graph-context overflow when the cache is combined with a quantized KV cache, avoiding failures in affected MoE configurations.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 MoE 快取圖溢出
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源 LLM 推論工具）現會預留 MoE 快取的圖節點，修正預算未計算快取路徑的問題。過去部分 MoE 模型配搭量化 KV 快取時，可能溢出圖上下文；更新後可避免此類失敗。同類亦可比較 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Domyn Edge 4B
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM runtime, added support for the Domyn Edge 4B model. Users can now incorporate the model into existing llama.cpp workflows, including GGUF conversion with updated tokenizer-hash generation and test fixes.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp新增Domyn Edge 4B
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp 是開源本地大型語言模型框架，新版加入 Domyn Edge 4B，並改善 GGUF 轉換的詞元雜湊與測試。以往此框架未支援該模型，現可接入既有流程，減少另建工具；同類工具亦可選 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Canary Build
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released a desktop canary build adding a host introduction for conversation history and fixes to the agent-sharing interface. Hosts can now frame shared conversations with an introduction, while visitor arrows, desktop selection states, and usage icons display more reliably.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat桌面Canary測試更新
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）推出桌面版Canary測試更新，可由主持人以開場白開啟對話記錄，並修正代理分享的訪客箭嘴、選取狀態及用量圖示。過往分享欠開場提示，現時介面更完整；同類選擇有AnythingLLM。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Reply Topic Naming
items.summary_en: LobeChat v0.0.155 lets channel members name the topic of a reply they manage. Users can now label a discussion clearly, making the relevant reply easier to identify and follow.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 可為頻道回覆命名主題
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天介面）發佈 cli-release v0.0.155，新增讓頻道成員為自己主辦的回覆命名主題。用戶以前較難辨識回覆重點，而家可直接標示討論脈絡，較易追蹤內容；同類選擇有 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: llamafile adds QK support on s390x
items.summary_en: llamafile, a single-file tool that packages language models with their runtime, added QK data-type support for IBM s390x and cleaned up platform-specific code. s390x users can now use QK data types through the updated llamafile build.
items.headline_zh: llamafile 新增 s390x QK 支援
items.summary_zh: llamafile 是整合語言模型與執行環境的單一檔案工具；新版為 IBM s390x 加入 QK 資料型態支援。用戶現可在 s390x 版本使用 QK 類型，毋須另找支援；需要底層控制，也可考慮 llama.cpp。

items.headline_en: Vercel Functions Raise Request Limit to 20MiB
items.summary_en: Vercel Functions, Vercel's serverless compute service, now accept inbound request bodies up to 20MiB, up from 4.5MB, in Public Beta. Developers can opt in with VERCEL_SUPPORT_LARGE_REQUEST_BODY=1; the project-wide setting requires the performance memory setting, so teams can test on preview before production and handle larger payloads beyond the old limit; AWS Lambda is a comparable alternative.
items.headline_zh: Vercel Functions 提升請求上限
items.summary_zh: Vercel Functions 屬 Vercel 無伺服器功能，公開測試版將請求主體上限由 4.5MB 升至 20MiB。開發者先在預覽環境測試，於正式環境啟用，較大內容可避開舊上限；同類選擇如 AWS Lambda。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds KleidiAI Support for HarmonyOS
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source AI model inference tool, enabled the KleidiAI OHOS (HarmonyOS) AArch64 target in release b12566. Developers can now integrate KleidiAI into inference on compatible HarmonyOS AArch64 devices, reducing custom platform-adaptation work.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 支援 OHOS ARM64
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源AI模型推論工具）b12566版本為KleidiAI加入OHOS AArch64目標。開發者可讓相容HarmonyOS ARM裝置使用最佳化功能，減少自行處理平台適配；同類選擇有MLC LLM。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Opens Folders via CLI
items.summary_en: LobeChat’s desktop app can now open a directory passed through `lh app`, whether as a bare path, with `--open-path`, or through a deep link, and queues the target while the app is not ready. Developers can jump from a terminal into the selected folder instead of opening a window that ignores its context; a deep link offers another launch route.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 支援用 CLI 開啟資料夾
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天桌面應用）新增 `lh app` 指令，可開啟終端機傳入的資料夾，並在程式未就緒時暫存目標。過往只會開啟未連到該資料夾的視窗；現在可由指令列直接進入目標，毋須手動尋找，亦可用深連結指定。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Bot
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.153 updates its bot feature so everyone in listed channels can use the owner's devices. This gives channel members access to the owner's device capabilities without each member needing separate device access.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 開放指定頻道共用擁有者裝置
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（開源 AI 聊天平台的命令列工具）更新 bot 功能，讓指定頻道所有成員使用擁有者的裝置。過往相關裝置只供擁有者使用，現時成員可直接使用；同類可選 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI lets agents manage Works
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released CLI v0.0.152 with support for agents to create, update, and delete Works. Users can delegate those work-item changes to agents instead of making each edit manually.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 代理可管理 Works
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天與代理平台）CLI v0.0.152 讓代理建立、更新及刪除 Works。用戶可交由代理處理工作項目，毋須逐項手動改動；Claude Code 等代理工具亦可比較。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes CUDA Matrix Precision
items.summary_en: The llama.cpp b12563 release keeps MUL_MAT_ID precision in the CUDA per-expert fallback and adds CUDA-only tests for matrix-multiplication results beyond the fp16 range. Users running large-batch IQ1_M inference on CUDA GPUs can avoid invalid infinite outputs caused by fp16 overflow.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 CUDA 矩陣精度
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源推論框架）b12563版本維持CUDA的MUL_MAT_ID精度，並新增CUDA測試。IQ1_M權重在大批次推論超出fp16範圍時可能輸出inf；新版可避免這類錯誤。同類選擇有Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp b12562 Optimizes Vulkan
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source language-model inference tool, released b12562 with an optimization to the Vulkan RMS_NORM_MUL_ROPE loop control. Vulkan users can pick up the targeted change through the normal release channel, without separately integrating the patch.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp優化Vulkan迴圈控制
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源語言模型推論工具）的b12562版，優化Vulkan後端的RMS_NORM_MUL_ROPE迴圈控制。Vulkan用戶可隨版本更新取得最佳化，毋須額外整合修正；同類選擇有llamafile。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI adds persistent artboards for discussions
items.summary_en: The LobeChat CLI, a command-line tool from the open-source AI chat framework, released v0.0.151 with persistent artboards and discussions on the board. Users can now keep a board for later instead of rebuilding it whenever they continue working on the same topic.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI新增持久畫板與討論
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天框架）的命令行工具CLI新增可保存artboard，並可在畫板上直接討論內容。用戶毋須每次重建工作板，現可保留版面再接着交流；同類選擇亦可留意ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.150 Released
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat framework, released CLI v0.0.150 with per-agent built-in management and a simplified marketplace. Previously, built-ins were harder to manage separately by agent; now users can configure them for each agent and set up the marketplace more easily.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 新增按代理管理功能
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天框架）推出 CLI v0.0.150，可按代理管理內建功能，並簡化市集設定。以前較難逐個代理配置內建功能，現在可為各代理個別管理，市集操作亦更省事；同類平台可比較 Dify。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds LoRA Nodes Across Architectures
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference engine, now assigns graph-node budgets within each model class. The update adds LoRA adapter nodes for every architecture instead of only selected ones, giving users more consistent adapter handling across models.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 為各架構加入LoRA節點
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地 AI 推論引擎）把圖節點預算移入模型類別，由各架構自行設定，並為所有架構加入 LoRA 配接器節點。用戶過往要辨識支援範圍，現可交由框架統一處理；同類選擇可留意 llamafile。

items.headline_en: n8n Releases 1.123.100
items.summary_en: n8n released version 1.123.100 on November 20, 2026.
items.headline_zh: n8n 發布 1.123.100 新版本
items.summary_zh: n8n（工作流程自動化軟件）於2026年11月20日推出1.123.100版本，但發布資料未列出新增功能或修正。用戶可按部署需要升級至新版，惟實際效益仍待功能細節確認；同類選擇可考慮Zapier。

items.headline_en: n8n 2.48.7 fixes core bugs
items.summary_en: n8n, a workflow automation tool, released 2.48.7 with fixes for a memory-guard hold and scripting-node error outputs. Scripting-node errors now include plain input data, making failed runs easier to troubleshoot; Zapier is another automation option.
items.headline_zh: n8n 2.48.7 修正記憶體與腳本錯誤
items.summary_zh: n8n（工作流程自動化工具）推出 2.48.7，修正記憶體守護停滯及腳本節點錯誤輸出。記憶體守護在停止時即使未釋放記憶體亦會結束，而腳本節點會把輸入資料寫入錯誤輸出，方便用戶排查失敗流程。同類平台可考慮 Zapier。

items.summary_en: n8n, a workflow automation tool, released version 2.49.3 with fixes across core functions, the HTTP Request Node, scripting nodes, and the editor. For users, these fixes make empty-response pagination more reliable, allow memory-guard holds to end correctly, aid script-error inspection with retained input data, and keep announcement menus interactive.
items.headline_zh: n8n 2.49.3 修正多項問題
items.summary_zh: n8n（流程自動化工具）發布2.49.3，修正核心與HTTP Request Node錯誤。過往分頁遇空白回應難處理，現可處理；記憶體保護於保留結束時解除，腳本錯誤輸出保留輸入。用戶做分頁、查錯更穩妥；同類如Zapier。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Channel-Based Bot Device Controls
items.summary_en: LobeChat now lets administrators scope a bot’s device-tool access by channel, with options for all channels or an allowlist; channels outside the list reject device tools even for the owner, while unscoped bots and direct messages keep their current behavior. This gives users finer control over where device actions can be used instead of exposing them across every channel.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 新增機器人按頻道限制裝置權限
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 是開源 AI 聊天平台，新版可按頻道限制機器人的裝置存取。管理員可設全部或允許名單，未列入頻道即拒絕工具。用戶可把裝置權限集中到指定頻道，不必全頻道開放，減少誤操作。同類需求可比較 Dify 等平台。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI shows readable Agent refusal reasons
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.148 fixes channel handling so a refused shared Agent reply fails with a readable reason. Users can identify why a request was declined instead of interpreting a vague error.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正拒答錯誤提示
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI 是 LobeChat 的命令列工具，v0.0.148 讓共享 Agent 拒答時顯示可讀的失敗原因。用戶毋須再猜測請求為何被拒，可更快定位問題並調整操作；同類工具可選 Claude Code。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Automatic Reply Language
items.summary_en: LobeChat v0.0.147 adds an Automatic default for agent reply language, prioritizes the user's message language over the fallback locale, and separates reply preferences from background-generation locales. This reduces the need to manually correct mismatched agent replies, while keeping manual language selection available.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 新增代理回覆語言自動選項
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（AI 聊天平台）發布 v0.0.147，代理回覆語言新增「自動」預設，並優先跟隨用戶訊息語言。以前設定不符時，代理或按備援語言作答；現在可減少用戶手動改語言及重複糾錯，偏好固定語言者仍可自行指定

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes WebGPU 2D Copy Indexing
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running large language models locally, released build b12565 to fix 2D indexing in its WebGPU copy kernel. Developers using WebGPU acceleration now have a corrected path for 2D copies during local inference.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正WebGPU二維索引
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp是讓大型語言模型在本地運行的開源工具，b12565修正WebGPU複製核心的2D索引。開發者以該介面加速本地推論時，過往可能出現二維索引錯誤，更新後可直接使用修正版核心；同類工具可選Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Optimizes CUDA MMVQ on Jetson Orin
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference tool, released b12564 with a dedicated Orin branch for calculating rows per block in CUDA single-column MMVQ. Jetson Orin users running quantized models can now use a hardware-specific path instead of the shared path, potentially improving local inference efficiency.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 優化 Orin MMVQ
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源推論工具）為 Jetson Orin 的 CUDA 單欄 MMVQ 加入專用區塊行數計算。過去 Orin 跑量化模型用共用路徑，現改用專用路徑，或可提升推論效率；同類可選 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp improves Vulkan inference
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference tool, added a chunked GATED_DELTA_NET implementation for Vulkan and enabled it by default. Users running local AI through Vulkan may see better performance, while fixes reduce NVIDIA shared-memory overuse and cm2 validation errors.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 優化 Vulkan 推論
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地AI推理工具）為Vulkan加入分塊GATED_DELTA_NET實作並預設啟用。用戶跑本地AI可望改善推論效能，亦修正NVIDIA共用記憶體過度佔用與cm2錯誤；簡單部署可選Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds WebGPU COL2IM_1D Support
items.summary_en: llama.cpp’s WebGPU backend now supports the COL2IM_1D operation for converting column data into image-like output. Developers can run compatible model graphs through WebGPU instead of encountering an unsupported operation.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp新增COL2IM_1D支援
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地大型語言模型推理框架）的WebGPU後端新增COL2IM_1D支援，可把欄位資料轉成影像式輸出。過往此運算未獲支援，現可交由瀏覽器圖形介面執行；本地推論亦可比較Ollama這類工具。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp release improves OpenCL Flash Attention efficiency
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, released build b12559 with an OpenCL optimization. Its f16 Flash Attention path previously handled the GQA head separately but can now fold it into the computation, potentially improving efficiency for users running compatible models through OpenCL.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 優化 OpenCL 推論效率
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地跑語言模型的開源框架）改進 OpenCL 加速。f16 Flash Attention 過往分開處理 GQA 頭，現可一併處理，讓相容模型用戶減少開銷、提升效率；本機部署可選 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes Adreno Decoding
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source large-language-model inference library, has disabled subgroup arithmetic in its Vulkan backend when using Qualcomm's proprietary Adreno driver. The change also turns off the affected ADD+RMS_NORM fusion and other subgroup-add paths, preventing incorrect decode-step normalization and reducing stray tokens after long prompts on affected Adreno systems.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 Adreno 解碼異常
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源推理程式庫）停用高通專有 Adreno 驅動的子群組運算，因分歧指令後加總可能出錯。過去長提示詞可令解碼正規化失真、模型吐出多餘詞元；新版關閉相關融合路徑，降低異常輸出。輝達可選 CUDA 後端。

items.headline_en: LobeChat lets approved visitors run local CLI agents
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, added the agent-share feature so approved visitors can run every local CLI agent. Visitors can now use the host's command-line setup through the platform instead of opening a terminal themselves, while the host retains permission control.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat授權訪客執行CLI Agent
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI平台）新增agent-share，讓獲授權訪客執行本機所有CLI Agent。以前要自行開終端機，現可在平台沿用分享者的工具，且授權由分享者控制。同類選擇是直接在終端機操作CLI Agent。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM RC fixes response stream retry handling
items.summary_en: LiteLLM, an open-source LLM routing gateway, released v1.111.0-rc.3 with a router fix that prevents a Responses stream from being retried after an output item reaches the client. This reduces the risk of delivered output being processed again and makes streaming behavior more predictable; OpenRouter is a comparable alternative.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM 修正串流送達後重試
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM（開源LLM路由閘道）v1.111.0-rc.3 修正 Responses 串流：輸出項目送達客戶端後，路由不再重試。用戶可避免已接收內容被再次處理，降低重複回應風險；同類可選 OpenRouter。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM patches key management
items.summary_en: LiteLLM, an open-source gateway for routing LLM API calls, released v1.106.12 with backported key-management fixes and dependency updates. Teams on the stable 1.106.x line can now receive the fixes without moving branches or backporting them themselves, easing maintenance; Portkey is a comparable option.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM v1.106.12修正鍵管理
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM（開源LLM API閘道）發布v1.106.12，鍵管理修正已回移至stable/1.106.x，並更新相關依賴。該分支用戶現可直接取得修正，毋須回移或轉版，減輕維護工作；同類選擇有Portkey。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI adds skill filters
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat framework, released CLI v0.0.145 with filters for skills that disable model invocation or have empty descriptions. Users can now narrow skill listings instead of checking entries individually; Claude Code is a comparable CLI option.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 新增技能篩選
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 對話框架）的 CLI 發布 v0.0.145，新增技能篩選功能，處理模型調用已關閉或描述為空的項目。用戶由逐項自行判斷，改為先由系統篩選；同類選擇可看 Claude Code。

items.headline_en: Vercel completes ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification
items.summary_en: Vercel has completed its ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification, meeting the international standard for AI management systems.This certification gives our customers confidence to ship fast with agents on Vercel, demonstrating how Vercel designs, builds, operates, and governs our AI products.Our AI management system covers Vercel’s underlying infrastructure and core AI products, including AI Gateway, Vercel Agent, v0, AI-based open source software and frameworks, as well as the people and processes beh

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.144 Refactors Prompt Order
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, LobeChat’s command-line interface, released v0.0.144 with a prompt refactor that places task-conditional framing before the available-information section. Task guidance now appears earlier in the prompt sequence, making the CLI’s request-building order easier to understand.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 重整提示詞次序
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（LobeChat 的命令列介面）發布 v0.0.144，重整提示詞，把任務條件框架移至可用資訊之前。過往相關說明排在後段，而家任務指示會更早呈現，令 CLI 的提示結構更清晰；同類選擇亦可比較 Aider。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Stops Recursive Skill Scanning
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat interface, released CLI v0.0.143 with a fix that stops recursive skill-directory scanning at SKILL.md. This avoids needless deeper searches once the skill file is found, making skill discovery more efficient.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI修正技能目錄遞迴
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI對話介面）嘅CLI推出v0.0.143，掃描技能目錄時會在SKILL.md停止遞迴，唔再繼續搜尋更深層內容。用戶查找技能可減少無謂重複掃描，令流程更有效率；同類選擇亦可比較Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Visitor Topics to Agent Sidebar
items.summary_en: In v0.0.142, LobeChat, an open-source AI chat workspace, adds visitor topics from shared Agents to the Agent sidebar. Shared-Agent owners can now spot visitor interests at a glance.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat Agent 側欄新增訪客主題
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天工作台）為 Agent 側欄加入分享訪客主題，讓 Agent 擁有人看到訪客瀏覽的話題；過往要自行翻查紀錄，現在可更快掌握訪客興趣，同類亦可選 Dify。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM Fix
items.summary_en: LiteLLM, an LLM API gateway, released v1.110.2 with a fix that stops its router retrying a Responses stream after an output item reaches the client. Users can now avoid retrying already-delivered output, reducing the risk of duplicate streamed responses.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM 修正串流重試
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM（大型語言模型 API 閘道）發布 v1.110.2，修復 Responses 串流在內容已送達客戶端後仍重試的問題。用戶可避免已接收輸出被重複處理，降低回應異常；同類可選 Portkey 等 AI 閘道。

items.headline_en: Gemini 4 Carbon input price up 25%
items.summary_en: Databricks' Gemini 4 Carbon model API, listed in the LiteLLM Price Registry, raised its input price by 25%, from $2.00 to $2.50 per 1 million tokens. Users should check expected token usage and adjust their budget before the next API bill.
items.headline_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 輸入價升25%
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM收錄的Gemini 4 Carbon是Databricks模型API，按輸入token計費，每百萬輸入token由2美元升至2.5美元。用戶現須多付0.5美元，宜先核算用量；不合預算可比較同類API。

items.headline_en: Gemini 4 Carbon Output Price Rises 25%
items.summary_en: The LiteLLM Price Registry shows output pricing for databricks/databricks-gemini-4-carbon rising 25%, from $10.00 to $12.50 per 1 million output tokens. Users can update their estimates before the next API bill.
items.headline_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon輸出價上調25%
items.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 是 LiteLLM 價格庫的 API 輸出計費項目，每百萬個輸出 token 的價格由 10 美元升至 12.5 美元。用戶由按 10 美元估算，改為按新價預算 API 成本；同類模型亦可比較。

items.headline_en: Gemini 4 Carbon Input Price Rises 25%
items.summary_en: The databricks/system.ai.gemini-4-carbon API now charges $2.50 per 1M input tokens, up from $2.00. Users should recalculate their API budget before the next billing cycle.
items.headline_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 輸入價格上調25%
items.summary_zh: databricks/system.ai.gemini-4-carbon 係經 LiteLLM 價格資料庫報價嘅模型 API；每百萬輸入 token 費用由 2.00 美元升至 2.50 美元。依家常用模型要重算 API 預算，成本敏感用量可比較其他模型。

items.headline_en: Databricks Gemini-4-carbon output price rises 25%
items.summary_en: The LiteLLM Price Registry lists databricks/system.ai.gemini-4-carbon at $12.50 per 1 million output tokens, up 25% from $10. Developers who previously estimated costs should recalculate their budget; lower-usage users can compare other model endpoints.
items.headline_zh: Gemini-4-carbon輸出單價升25%
items.summary_zh: Databricks的Gemini-4-carbon模型API，每百萬個輸出token單價由10美元升至12.50美元，LiteLLM價格註冊表顯示漲幅25%。過往估算的開發者，現應重算預算；用量少可比較其他模型端點。

items.headline_en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen input cost rises
items.summary_en: LiteLLM's price registry shows the databricks/system.ai.gemini-4-hydrogen API input price rose 25%, from $1.50 to $1.88 per 1 million tokens. Users can check their expected usage costs before the next API bill.
items.headline_zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 輸入價格上升
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM 價格資料庫顯示，databricks/system.ai.gemini-4-hydrogen API 輸入價由每百萬 tokens 收費 1.50 美元升至 1.88 美元。用戶下次帳單前可先檢查用量，估算新增成本。

items.headline_en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen Output Price Rises 25%
items.summary_en: databricks/system.ai.gemini-4-hydrogen is a token-billed AI API listed in LiteLLM's price registry, and its output price rose 25% from $7.50 to $9.38 per 1 million tokens. Developers with unchanged output volume should revise their expected costs before the next bill, because the same usage now costs more.
items.headline_zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen輸出價升25%
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM收錄的system.ai.gemini-4-hydrogen是按token計費的AI API，輸出價升25%至每百萬token為9.38美元。同用量費用增，重算預算並比較其他模型報價。

items.headline_en: LobeChat expands shared agent access
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released v0.0.141, adding shared-agent access across contacts’ devices and always-redacted visible content. Users can now let agents handle devices across contacts while keeping displayed details masked, reducing the need to manage each device separately; Open WebUI is a similar self-hosted option.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat擴大共享代理裝置存取
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天平台）發布v0.0.141，共享代理可存取各聯絡人的裝置，並把可見內容持續遮蔽。用戶由前要自行處理各裝置權限，現在可讓代理接觸更多裝置同時保留隱私；同類選擇可考慮Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM v1.109.3 Refreshes Wolfi Base
items.summary_en: LiteLLM, an open-source AI gateway that standardizes access to model APIs, released v1.109.3 with a Wolfi base refresh. Users get the revised Linux base through the release rather than tracking that refresh separately, although no user-facing feature changes are listed; Portkey offers a similar gateway.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM 更新 Wolfi 基礎環境
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM（開源 AI 閘道）統一模型服務 API，今次發布 v1.109.3，更新 Wolfi 基礎環境。用戶更新部署時可取得新版 Linux 基礎，毋須另行處理映像更新；未見功能改動。同類可選 Portkey。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM releases v1.108.13
items.summary_en: LiteLLM, an open-source gateway that lets developers call and manage different language models through one interface, released v1.108.13 with a change backported to the LTS 1.1 branch. The supplied note does not specify the change, but users on that maintenance line can now receive it by updating in place rather than switching branches, with Portkey as a comparable option.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM 發布 v1.108.13
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM是讓開發者以統一介面呼叫及管理不同語言模型的開源工具；v1.108.13將一項更新回移至LTS 1.1分支。發布資料未交代更新細節，LTS版本用戶過往或要跨到較新分支，現可留在原線更新；同類選擇有Portkey

items.headline_en: Nemotron output price falls 6%
items.summary_en: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B is a model API whose output-token price in LiteLLM's registry fell 6%, from $0.50 to $0.47 per 1M tokens. Users billed for model output can check the lower rate before their next API purchase.
items.headline_zh: Nemotron API輸出價下調6%
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM價格庫顯示，NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B API輸出價下調6%，每百萬token由0.50美元降至0.47美元。用戶輸出成本隨之下降；同類模型API可再比價。

items.headline_en: Codex CLI releases Rust alpha build
items.summary_en: OpenAI’s terminal coding agent Codex CLI released its Rust-based v0.173.0-alpha.1 build. Developers can now try the alpha channel earlier rather than waiting for a stable release, though no feature details were listed; stable Codex or another terminal coding agent is a more conservative alternative.
items.headline_zh: Codex CLI 發布 Rust alpha 版
items.summary_zh: Codex CLI（終端 AI 編碼代理）推出 Rust 版 v0.173.0-alpha.1。過往要等正式版，現可先試 alpha 通道，惟未列功能變更；求穩定可選 Codex 穩定版或其他終端 coding agent。

items.headline_en: LangGraph 1.2.24 fixes checkpoint edge cases
items.summary_en: LangGraph, an open-source framework for orchestrating AI agents, released version 1.2.24 with fixes for removing all messages and handling None checkpoints. Developers can now clear messages and process empty checkpoints with fewer edge-case failures.
items.headline_zh: LangGraph 1.2.24 修正訊息與檢查點
items.summary_zh: LangGraph（開源 AI 代理框架）推出 1.2.24，修復移除全部訊息及空檢查點的處理錯誤。開發者以前清除訊息或使用空檢查點時或會失敗，現在可減少這類邊界問題；同類選擇可考慮 CrewAI。

items.headline_en: Introducing SWE-2 Flash 2026.11.04 We’re introducing SWE-2 Flash, a fully American coding model that sets a new bar for intelligence at low cost and high speed.
items.summary_en: New post on Cognition Blog: Introducing SWE-2 Flash 2026.11.04 We’re introducing SWE-2 Flash, a fully American coding model that sets a new bar for intelligence at low cost and high speed.

items.headline_en: Cerebras Launches Disaggregated Inference
items.summary_en: Cerebras, an AI chip and systems company, launched disaggregated inference. The approach splits inference stages across computing resources, potentially giving AI teams more flexibility in tuning serving workloads.
items.headline_zh: Cerebras 推出解耦推理
items.summary_zh: Cerebras 是 AI 晶片與系統公司，新推出解耦推理，可把推理不同階段分配到不同運算資源。過往若各階段共用資源，現時可按工作負載分開配置，有助紓緩效能瓶頸；沿用 GPU 生態的團隊亦可比較 NVIDIA 平台。

items.headline_en: Groq Raises $350M for AI Inference Cloud
items.summary_en: Groq, an AI chip and cloud company focused on inference, has closed a $350 million Series A to build its AI inference cloud. For users, the funding may bring more inference-service options, though no pricing, availability, or launch timeline was announced.
items.headline_zh: Groq 獲 3.5 億美元 A 輪融資建推理雲
items.summary_zh: Groq 係專注 AI 推理嘅晶片及雲端平台，今完成 3.5 億美元 A 輪融資，用於建設 AI 推理雲。用戶日後或可因此有更多推理服務選擇，但公告未列明定價、開放範圍或推出時間；同類選擇可留意其他 AI 推理雲服務商。

items.headline_en: Fireworks AI Introduces Ember-1
items.summary_en: Fireworks AI, an AI model inference platform, introduced Ember-1 on September 23, 2026. The announcement provides no details about its features, performance, or use cases, so developers cannot yet judge whether it improves on their existing options.
items.headline_zh: Fireworks AI推出Ember-1
items.summary_zh: Fireworks AI（AI模型推論平台）推出Ember-1，惟公告只確認新模型登場，未交代功能、效能或適用情境。對開發者而言，以前沿用原有模型，現在多一個候選可評估，未宜一早取代原方案；其他模型亦可比較。

items.summary_en: New post on AI21 Blog: Nov 5, 2026 Introducing Teel – Turbo-Efficient Execution Library for Agents (but not only)

items.summary_en: New post on Anthropic News: Anthropic prices initial public offering

items.headline_en: Google DeepMind Opens AI Weather Model Datasets
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind is opening the datasets behind its AI weather models. Researchers can now inspect the underlying data to study and evaluate these systems, while numerical weather forecasting remains a comparable alternative.
items.headline_zh: Google DeepMind開放AI天氣資料集
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind是Google旗下AI研究團隊，今次公開其AI天氣模型背後的資料集。過往底層資料未公開，外部研究者現可直接查閱，了解及評估模型；傳統數值天氣預報亦可作比較。

items.headline_en: ByteDance Seed Publishes Home Models Blog
items.summary_en: ByteDance Seed, ByteDance’s AI research team, published a new “Home Models” blog post with a “Publication” label and a “Seed Edge — Join Us” invitation. Readers can now go directly to the official post, although the update gives no details about its contents.
items.headline_zh: Seed 發布 Home Models 博客
items.summary_zh: ByteDance Seed（字節跳動的AI研究團隊）發布Home Models博客文章，並附Seed Edge「Join Us」邀請，細節未交代。過往要自行搜尋，現可從頁面直接查看；同類選擇可看其他模型團隊的技術博客。

items.headline_en: StepFun Explains AI Studio
items.summary_en: StepFun News published an “About AI Studio” post introducing the model API open platform. It gives developers an official starting point for understanding the service before deciding whether to explore an API integration.
items.headline_zh: StepFun 發文介紹 AI Studio
items.summary_zh: StepFun 發布 AI Studio「關於我們」文章，介紹這款模型 API 開放平台。過去要自行查找平台背景，現在可先從官方說明掌握服務定位，再判斷是否適合接入；同類選擇可比較其他模型 API 服務商。

items.headline_en: Zhipu Offers 20M Free GLM Tokens
items.summary_en: Zhipu, a large independent Chinese AI-model developer, is offering free trials of its domestically developed GLM architecture. New users can test with 20 million free tokens without paying upfront, while security researchers can report vulnerabilities to ZSRC.
items.headline_zh: 智譜開放 GLM 免費試用
items.summary_zh: 智譜是中國大型獨立大模型廠商，其 GLM 為國產原創模型架構，開放免費試用。用戶註冊即可得到 2000 萬 tokens，毋須預先付費便能開始測試模型；安全研究者亦可向 ZSRC 報告漏洞。同類選擇可選 DeepSeek。

items.headline_en: MiniMax H3 for video and images
items.summary_en: MiniMax H3 is MiniMax’s AI model for creating video and images. Users can handle both media types through one model rather than switching between separate tools; Adobe Firefly is a comparable option.
items.headline_zh: MiniMax H3 影片與圖像模型
items.summary_zh: MiniMax H3 是 MiniMax 博客介紹、聚焦影片與圖像生成的 AI 模型。過往要分開處理兩類素材，現可把影片及圖像創作集中於同一工具；同類選擇可看 Adobe Firefly。

items.headline_en: DeepSeek Post Lists Multiple Models
items.summary_en: DeepSeek published a post listing V4.1, V4, V3.2, V3.1, R1, and V3 without detailing new features. The post gives users one place to scan model names, while comparable model families include ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
items.headline_zh: DeepSeek貼文列出多款模型
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek（AI模型開發商）的貼文列出V4.1、V4、V3.2、V3.1、R1及V3，卻未交代新功能。用戶可集中查看模型名稱，毋須逐個搜尋；同類選擇有ChatGPT、Claude與Gemini。

items.headline_en: As AI agents take on more work, Microsoft makes Windows more secure
items.summary_en: The post As AI agents take on more work, Microsoft makes Windows more secure appeared first on Source .

items.headline_en: AWS reviews 13 more SageMaker inference launches
items.summary_en: Amazon SageMaker, AWS's cloud AI deployment service, is the focus of a second 2026 roundup covering 13 more inference launches. The updates span configuration guidance, fitting more models onto each GPU, serving models too large for one instance, cross-Region routing, and post-launch tuning, giving users more deployment choices.
items.headline_zh: SageMaker 13項AI推論更新
items.summary_zh: Amazon SageMaker 是 AWS AI 部署服務；本文盤點2026年13項推論更新，含配置建議、單張 GPU 多載模型、跨區路由及部署後調校。面對單一實例容量限制，用戶部署更靈活。亦可選 Azure ML。

items.headline_en: Ollama improves ChatGPT CLI and MLX
items.summary_en: Ollama, a local AI model runner, released v0.40.17 with improved ChatGPT CLI restoration and graceful restarts, OpenCode thinking-metadata support, and concurrent MLX generation. Users can restart local-model workflows more reliably and generate concurrently on MLX, while Vulkan integrated GPUs use memory-mapped model handling.
items.headline_zh: Ollama v0.40.17 優化 CLI 與 MLX
items.summary_zh: Ollama（本地 AI 模型運行工具）發布 v0.40.17，ChatGPT CLI 恢復與重啟更可靠，MLX 支援同時生成。用戶以往重啟較不順，現時流程更可靠；並行生成亦可減等待。同類選擇可考慮 LM Studio。

items.headline_en: An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.
items.summary_en: wangzan101/Mika - An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you. Gained 10,015 GitHub stars in 28 days (~363/day).

items.headline_en: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs.
items.summary_en: agentes-chat/agentes-chat - Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0. Gained 2,055 GitHub stars in 17 days (~120/day).

items.headline_en: AnyModelBot Connects 70+ AI Models
items.summary_en: AnyModelBot is an open-source, local-first platform that lets users run personal bots across 70+ models, including GPT, Claude and Gemini, through one Modelflare key. Bots are reachable in the app, WeChat or Feishu, can remember users, work in the background, run commands and use the user's computer, giving users one-key access to multiple models with pay-per-use billing; Grok Bot is a similar alternative.
items.headline_zh: AnyModelBot 整合 70+ AI 模型
items.summary_zh: AnyModelBot（開源本機優先 AI 助理）以單一 key 接通 70+ 模型，可經 App、微信或飛書。用戶毋須逐款配置，可讓 bot 記憶、後台工作、執行指令及操作電腦，按用量付費；同類選擇有 Grok Bot。

items.headline_en: Sapper v2, an AI Pentest System, Wins 634-Team Challenge
items.summary_en: Sapper v2 is an autonomous, evolvable AI pentesting system from Nüwa Foundation’s Create, Language and History components, and it won a challenge among 634 teams after eight unattended hours. Users can grow and evolve their own agents for unattended testing instead of manually chaining every step, and the project gained 2,491 GitHub stars in 20 days.
items.headline_zh: Sapper v2奪634隊AI滲透挑戰冠軍
items.summary_zh: Sapper v2（Nüwa Foundation的AI滲透測試專案）可建立、演化並支援8小時無人值守運行的代理，在634隊挑戰中奪冠。用戶毋須再自行串接流程，可讓代理持續工作；同類選擇可比較PentestGPT。

items.headline_en: STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified
items.summary_en: Dodaios/ste80-humanizer - STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared. Gained 1,136 GitHub stars in 16 days (~69/day).

items.headline_en: trnrt Enables LLM Inference on AWS Trainium
items.summary_en: trnrt is an open LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium with NKI megakernels, 1M-token context, and an OpenAI-compatible API. Developers can use a familiar API on Trainium instead of building a custom integration while handling long contexts; the repository gained 1,638 GitHub stars in 20 days.
items.headline_zh: trnrt 支援 Trainium 大模型推理
items.summary_zh: trnrt 是 AWS Trainium 的開源推理引擎，採用 NKI megakernels、百萬 token 上下文及 OpenAI 相容 API。用戶可沿用接口部署，減少整合並處理長上下文；同類選擇有 vLLM。

items.headline_en: Run models larger than your RAM or VRAM by streaming MoE experts from SSD.
items.summary_en: wici-ai/inferssd - Run models larger than your RAM or VRAM by streaming MoE experts from SSD. Built on llama.cpp. Gained 1,275 GitHub stars in 30 days (~43/day).

items.headline_en: Turbo Browser MCP Streamlines Playwright Automation
items.summary_en: Turbo Browser MCP is a Playwright MCP server offering one-call form filling, delta snapshots, batched steps, and a submit guard enabled by default; it gained 132 GitHub stars in five days. By reducing browser-agent turns and token use versus step-by-step control, it simplifies automation, while Microsoft Playwright MCP is another option.
items.headline_zh: Turbo Browser MCP 精簡自動化
items.summary_zh: Turbo Browser MCP 係 Playwright 自動化伺服器，支援一次填表、增量快照、批次操作及預設提交保護。過往逐項操作增加輪次與 token 消耗，現在可精簡流程；可選微軟 Playwright MCP。

items.headline_en: Inside LLM Compares Quantized GGUF Models
items.summary_en: Inside LLM is a browser-based tool that reveals where two GGUF quantizations diverge token by token and shows how different samplers affect outputs. Users can compare model behavior directly instead of manually checking results from separate runs.
items.headline_zh: Inside LLM 比較 GGUF 量化差異
items.summary_zh: Inside LLM 是一個瀏覽器模型比較工具，可逐 token 比較兩個 GGUF 量化模型的分歧，並查看不同採樣器如何影響輸出。用戶毋須逐個載入模型再肉眼對照，現在亦可用 LM Studio 或 llama.cpp。

items.headline_en: Agent skill for hill-climbing local LLM serving speed (decode, speculative decoding, prefill, KV, startup, TTF
items.summary_en: sybil-solutions/inference-optimisation-skill - Agent skill for hill-climbing local LLM serving speed (decode, speculative decoding, prefill, KV, startup, TTFT) on any hardware and quantization Gained 2,716 GitHub stars in 9 days (~289/day).

items.headline_en: 32 Free Marketing Skills for AI Agents
items.summary_en: Boring Marketing Skills is a free MIT-licensed GitHub repository offering 32 AI-agent skills for research, positioning, copy, pages, SEO, AI search, ads, email, content, and local-business work. Users can use an existing marketing toolkit instead of building every capability separately; the repository gained 698 GitHub stars in three days.
items.headline_zh: AI Agent 獲32項免費行銷技能
items.summary_zh: Boring Marketing Skills 是 GitHub 上免費、MIT 授權的 AI Agent 行銷技能包，涵蓋研究、文案、SEO、廣告與電郵等32項。以前要逐項自建，現可接入；同類選擇包括自建專門技能。

items.headline_en: Repdix Telegram Bot: Community-Driven Natural Language Database Orchestrator with Local LLM Support
items.summary_en: bhukyabalu12/repdix-telegram-bot - Repdix Telegram Bot: Community-Driven Natural Language Database Orchestrator with Local LLM Support Gained 153 GitHub stars in 5 days (~28/day).

items.headline_en: Craft adds design workflows for AI agents
items.summary_en: Craft is a set of design skills for AI agents that writes a design brief, creates screens covering every state from a design system, and reviews the results. It works with Paper, pen.dev, Figma, or HTML, letting users automate briefs, interface states, and reviews that previously required manual design work; similar alternatives include AI UI generators.
items.headline_zh: Craft 為 AI 代理加入設計流程
items.summary_zh: Craft 是一套供 AI 代理使用的設計技能，可先撰寫設計簡報，再按設計系統製作涵蓋各種狀態的介面並加以審查。它支援 Paper、pen.dev、Figma 或 HTML；以往要手動整理要求及檢查狀態，現在可交由代理處理，四天內獲得了 271 個 GitHub 星標。同類選擇還有 AI UI 生成工具。

items.headline_en: Voicebox Enables Offline Voice Cloning on Android

model : hrm : do not compute slot count as uint32_t ( #32601 ) load_arch_hparams multiplies n_hrm_layers_per_stack, n_hrm_h_cycles and (n_hrm_l_cycles + 1) into a uint32_t, then asserts the product equals block_count. Any factors whose true product is block_count + k*2^32 still pass the assert; 1073741825 * 2 * 2 = 2^32 + 4 compares equal to block_count = 4. load_arch_tensors iterates the same three values in int and writes past the end of the block_count-sized layers vector. items.headline_en: b12533: CUDA: use 64-bit dst offsets in mul_mat_q (#32374)
items.summary_en: The MMQ kernels computed the dst tile offset (jt J stride_col_dst) in 32-bit int. For a dst with more than 2^31 elements, column tiles that start past INT_MAX/nrows wrap around and write out of bounds. This happens with an all-logits output head, e.g. llama-perplexity -c 32768 -b 32768 -ub 16384 on a 248320-vocab model: the q8_0 output matmul has a 248320 x 16384 dst (4.07e9 elements) and aborts with an illegal memory access. cuda: use the implicit GEMM conv2d path for F32 kernels ( #32482 ) The fast CONV_2D path (implicit GEMM with MMA, or cuBLAS for pointwise convolutions) required an F16 kernel. F32 kernels fell back to the naive direct convolution, which is much slower than im2col + mul_mat on large channel counts. Convert F32 kernels to F16 in a pool buffer, as is already done for the input, and take the same path with F32 accumulation. The Metal implicit GEMM kernel already stages both operands as F16. items.headline_en: Reducing token costs and latency in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore JSON workloads
items.summary_en: As production agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore process multi-megabyte JSON payloads, token costs and latency climb. This post shares three composable strategies: offloading heavy artifacts to Amazon S3, on-demand result paging, and dictionary compaction. Together they cut per-turn token use by up to 71% and latency by up to 80%.

Learn how it works, when to use it compared with prefix-aware routing, and how to enable, invoke, and verify it on single model and inference component endpoints.

items.summary_zh: Claude（Anthropic 開發的 AI 對話助手）的狀態頁顯示輕微服務中斷。遇到回應異常，用戶現可先查狀態頁，而毋須立即怪罪提示詞，更易分辨是平台故障抑或自身輸入問題。同類選擇另有 ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: Gemini Config Checker finds proxy configurations for Google AI Studio and Gemini
items.summary_en: Gemini Config Checker is a GitHub utility that finds proxy configurations for accessing Google AI Studio and Gemini using a signed-in browser check, plus anti-DPI support on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android. It saves users from testing proxy chains one by one; dedicated proxy-testing tools are a similar alternative (the repository gained 474 GitHub stars in one day).
items.headline_zh: Gemini Config Checker找代理
items.summary_zh: Gemini Config Checker 是 GitHub 代理檢查器，可找能連上 Google AI Studio、Gemini 的代理鏈，並做防 DPI 檢查。以前要逐項試，現在可檢查連線結果；同類可選代理測試器。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp optimizes KV-cache cleanup
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, released b12432 to avoid scanning every KV-cache cell when removing a sequence. This can reduce cleanup overhead for users managing concurrent inference workloads; another local-inference option is Ollama.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 優化 KV-cache 清理
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機模型推論框架）發布 b12432，移除序列時避開 KV-cache cells 的線性掃描，降低清理開銷。用戶管理多個並行推論序列時，可減少逐格搜尋成本。同類選擇可看 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Returns 400 for Unsupported Reasoning Levels
items.summary_en: The b12431 llama.cpp server release rejects unsupported reasoning_effort levels with HTTP 400 instead of triggering HTTP 500 errors on the chat completions, responses, and messages endpoints. API clients can now distinguish an invalid setting from an internal server failure.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正無效推理等級回應
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地AI推理軟件）更新後，模板不接受的 reasoning_effort 等級會回傳400，不再於伺服器端點變成500。用戶可分辨設定錯誤與伺服器故障；同類本地推理解法可選 Ollama。

items.summary_en: Workflow automation platform n8n released version 1.123.97 on November 16, 2026. The supplied notice lists no feature or fix details, so users would need the full release notes to judge the update’s practical impact.

Those models can now run through the same authentication, SDKs and APIs, and observability as catalog models, so every model your team uses is managed in one place.Use Private Inference to:Switch between private and catalog models: Call private models through Chat Completions, Responses, or Messages. items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes HIP MoE Regression
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference framework, released b12430 with a fix for a ggml-cuda regression affecting Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference on AMD's HIP platform. Users with affected setups can update to restore expected behavior, while CPU inference remains an option for systems without an AMD GPU.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修復 HIP MoE 回歸
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地 AI 推論框架）發布 b12430，修復 ggml-cuda 在 HIP 運行 MoE（混合專家模型）的回歸問題。過往異常推論現可恢復正常；沒有 AMD GPU，也可改用 CPU 推論。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp adds four missing Jinja features
items.summary_en: The b12428 release adds four missing Jinja features and fixes an error message. Users can work with more template patterns and get clearer guidance when template handling fails.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 補強 Jinja 模板功能
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地大型語言模型推論工具）的 b12428 版本，新增 4 項欠缺的 Jinja 模板功能並修正錯誤訊息。過往部分模板寫法或無法支援，現可涵蓋更多用法，排查錯誤也更清楚；同類選擇有 Ollama。

items.headline_en: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea's AI Sector
items.summary_en: The two-day AI Day Seoul at COEX brought more than 2,000 industry leaders, startups, and developers together around physical AI and AI agents. Attendees could engage with all three groups in one place rather than seek out each community separately.

items.headline_en: LiteLLM Adopts Keyless Release Signing
items.summary_en: LiteLLM releases from v1.111.0-dev.3 onward use Sigstore keyless signing through GitHub OIDC instead of the cosign.pub key. To verify v1.111.0-dev.4, use the certificate-identity verification command rather than `cosign verify --key ...`, which no longer works; older releases still support key-based verification.
